#### 148a (5 Nov 2026): SUARA ADEGAN HEADER SELESAI dan LULUS uji (butir 18); `daily-log.html` = v148a
- **Apa yang dikerjakan:** modul baru `v148a` (satu blok setelah `/* ===== /v110 sambungan ===== */`, penanda `/* ===== v148a ... ===== */` ... `/* ===== /v148a suara adegan ===== */`; CSS tombol di samping CSS v110). Suara disintesis penuh lewat Web Audio (tanpa berkas audio, tanpa unduhan): derau putih/merah muda/cokelat bebas sambungan (ekor dicampur ke kepala, daya sama), filter biquad, LFO penggerak gain dan frekuensi (embusan angin, ombak naik turun), osilator (dengung, desau), dan 17 jenis kejadian acak proses Poisson (burung, jangkrik, katak, burung hantu, tetes, gelembung, letupan api, guntur, camar, gagak, elang, lonceng, sirene kabut, klakson jauh, derak rel, tik jam, balik halaman, derit kayu).
- **Tabel `SND` (butir 18c): resep untuk 17 adegan** (airterjun, padang, dusun, kastil, danau, reruntuhan, pantai, pegunungan, kereta, akuarium, atap, lorong, perpus, embun, mercu, kapal, gerbang). Tiap resep = lapisan dasar + kejadian, lalu `ctxRec` menyesuaikan menurut JAM (fajar 05.00-07.30, siang, senja 17.00-19.00, malam: burung hanya fajar/siang/senja, jangkrik dan katak senja/malam, burung hantu malam/fajar) dan CUACA (hujan: desis hujan + tetes; badai: lebih keras + guntur + angin 2,4x; salju dan kabut: filter lolos-rendah meredam, salju lebih pelan; mendung: angin 1,35x). Cuaca terdengar tiga cara: di luar, dalam ruangan (`kereta`, `perpus`: hujan teredam 45 persen), di bawah air (`gerbang`: 22 persen, guntur teredam); `akuarium` tidak terpengaruh cuaca. Kekerasan per adegan dikalibrasi lewat render luring (`CAL`, target -28 sampai -38 dBFS RMS siang cerah; cuaca tidak ikut dikalikan agar hujan sama keras di semua adegan).
- **Perilaku (butir 18b):** tombol speaker bulat kecil di pojok kanan atas header (`#hxSky>.sndbtn`, di luar daftar ketuk-3x sehingga tidak memicu mode animasi; di mode animasi tombol tetap terlihat 60 persen dan bisa diketuk). BAWAAN MATI dan tidak ada `AudioContext` sebelum pengguna mengetuk. Pilihan tersimpan di `localStorage['dailylog:snd:on']`; bila tersimpan MENYALA, setelah muat ulang suara mulai pada ketukan pertama di mana saja (aturan peramban). Diam otomatis (gain ke 0 dalam kira-kira 1 detik, `AudioContext` ditangguhkan sesudah 2,5 detik) saat tab tersembunyi, tampilan bukan Beranda, atau latar pixel dimatikan (`dailylog:pxbg:off`). Pergantian adegan (tiap jam) atau cuaca/jam: silang-pudar 2,5 detik. Volume lembut (master 0,34 + pemampat dinamis). Tanpa tombol, tanpa ketuk: tidak ada suara.
- **Uji (`test148a.py`, VONIS: LULUS, 31 pemeriksaan):** A1-A8 statik (17 resep, semua angka sah pada 17 adegan x 4 jam x 6 cuaca, semua jenis kejadian ada, resep tiap adegan unik 17/17, cuaca dan jam mengubah resep, tanpa burung saat malam, tanpa burung/jangkrik saat hujan/badai/salju); B1-B6 luring (17 adegan x 5 kondisi = 85 render 5 detik: tanpa NaN, puncak < 0,9, RMS -50..-22 dBFS, spektrum 9 pita antar adegan jarak L1 minimum >= 0,08 (awalnya `pantai` dan `mercu` hanya 0,033, GAGAL, lalu dibedakan: pantai lebih desis, mercu lebih dalam dan angin kuat), hujan terdengar beda dari cerah, salju tidak lebih keras dari cerah); C1-C17 langsung di Chromium (bawaan mati tanpa AudioContext, klik menyalakan, tersimpan, resep aktif = adegan header, kejadian terjadwal terus, tab tersembunyi diam, pindah ke Latihan diam, kembali ke Beranda bersuara, latar pixel mati diam, mode animasi, 3 ketukan tidak memicu mode animasi, dimatikan = suspended, muat ulang belum ada AudioContext sebelum ketukan, ketukan pertama memulai, nol galat halaman). Uji pertama gagal di B4, C6, C9; C6 dan C9 ternyata salah uji (pengubahan `curView` dari luar tidak mungkin karena variabel itu tertutup; kejadian jarang di adegan pantai), diperbaiki dengan klik tab nyata dan adegan `akuarium` (gelembung rapat).
- **Pemeriksaan aturan adegan (148a): [1 satu adegan baru: BELUM di 148a, dikerjakan di 148b setelah serah ini (utang jujur: rencana awal 148 hanya memuat suara dan tidak menyebut adegan baru, padahal aturan tetap mewajibkannya tiap pembaruan)] [2-17 tidak berlaku: tidak ada adegan baru atau perubahan gambar] [18 suara adegan: dipenuhi untuk 17 adegan, bukti uji di atas].** Nama dan sumber inspirasi tidak disebut di obrolan.
- **BELUM / BATAS (jujur):** (1) saya tidak bisa MENDENGAR hasilnya; kualitas bunyi dinilai lewat angka (RMS, spektrum, jadwal kejadian), bukan telinga. Pemilik perlu mencoba di HP dan memberi tahu bila ada lapisan yang terdengar aneh, terlalu keras, atau terlalu berulang. (2) Hanya Chromium desktop; Safari iOS (AudioContext bisa berstatus `interrupted`) dan WebView Android belum diuji. (3) Mutan 148a BELUM dijalankan di titik serah ini (dijadwalkan segera setelah serah; hasil dicatat di entri berikutnya). (4) Suara tidak mengikuti `prefers-reduced-motion` (suara bukan gerak). (5) Adegan ke-18 belum ada, jadi belum punya resep `SND` (wajib saat dibuat, butir 18c).

## ALAT UJI SUARA 148a (disimpan supaya tidak hilang; kode suara = blok `v148a` di daily-log.html)
**Pakai:** `python3 patch148a.py in.html snd148.js out.html` (snd148.js = isi blok v148a, ekstrak dengan penanda di atas), `python3 test148a.py <html>` (tambah argumen `cepat` untuk versi ringkas), `python3 cal148a.py <html>` (RMS per adegan), `python3 mut148a.py <html> [indeks,indeks]` (mutan cepat suara, 11 mutan, ditambah 148a2; test148a.py kini punya A9 fajar/senja).
```patch148a.py
# patch148a.py: pasang suara adegan header. Pakai: python3 patch148a.py in.html snd148.js out.html   |  balik: python3 patch148a.py --reverse in.html out.html
import sys, re
CSS = """/* ===== v148a: tombol suara adegan di header (butir 18) ===== */
#hxSky>.sndbtn{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:3;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#hxSky>.sndbtn svg{width:16px;height:16px}
#hxSky>.sndbtn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.36);color:#fff}
#hxSky>.sndbtn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
#v-home.skyfocus #hxSky>.sndbtn{opacity:.6!important;pointer-events:auto!important}
/* ===== /v148a ===== */
"""
A = "@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#hxSky>.pxbg.pxold{transition:none}}\n"
B = "/* ===== /v110 sambungan ===== */\n"
if sys.argv[1] == '--reverse':
    s = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read()
    s2 = re.sub(r"/\* ===== v148a: tombol suara adegan.*?/\* ===== /v148a ===== \*/\n", "", s, flags=re.S)
    s2 = re.sub(r"/\* ===== v148a: suara adegan header.*?/\* ===== /v148a suara adegan ===== \*/\n", "", s2, flags=re.S)
    open(sys.argv[3], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s2); print('dibalik', len(s), '->', len(s2)); sys.exit()
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); js = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read()
assert s.count(A) == 1 and s.count(B) == 1 and 'v148a' not in s, (s.count(A), s.count(B))
s = s.replace(A, A + CSS).replace(B, B + js)
open(sys.argv[3], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))
```
```test148a.py
# test148a.py: uji suara adegan 148a. Pakai: python3 test148a.py <berkas.html> [cepat]
import sys, os, json, itertools
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]); quick = len(sys.argv) > 2
fails = []
def chk(name, ok, info=''):
    print(('OK   ' if ok else 'GAGAL'), name, info)
    if not ok: fails.append(name)
STAT = r'''() => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = { bad: [], keys: {}, empty: [], evbad: [], birdsNight: [], birdsRain: [], sceneJson: {}, wxSame: [], phSame: [], duskSame: [], dawnSame: [] };
 const WX = ['clear','cloud','fog','rain','storm','snow'], MIN = [360, 780, 1080, 1320], sc = S.scenes();
 for (const s of sc) for (const m of MIN) for (const w of WX) { const r = S.recipe(s, m, w); if (!r) { out.empty.push([s, m, w]); continue; }
  const num = [r.vol, r.lp]; r.beds.forEach(L => num.push(L.g, L.hz, L.f === undefined ? 1 : L.f)); r.ev.forEach(E => { num.push(E.r, E.g); if (!S.EV.includes(E.k)) out.evbad.push([s, E.k]); });
  if (num.some(x => !isFinite(x) || x < 0) || r.vol <= 0 || r.vol > 1.2 || !r.beds.length) out.bad.push([s, m, w]);
  if (r.ph === 'night' && r.ev.some(E => E.k === 'bird')) out.birdsNight.push([s, m, w]);

  if (m === 780 && w === 'clear') out.sceneJson[s] = JSON.stringify([r.beds, r.ev]); }
 for (const s of sc) { if (s === 'akuarium') continue; const a = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').ev]), b = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').ev]); if (a === b) out.wxSame.push(s); }

 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 1080, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.duskSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 360, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.dawnSame.push(s); }
 out.n = sc.length; out.uniq = new Set(Object.values(out.sceneJson)).size; return out; }'''
OFF = r'''async (cases) => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = {};
 const fft = (re, im) => { const n = re.length; for (let i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) { let b = n >> 1; for (; j & b; b >>= 1) j ^= b; j ^= b; if (i < j) { [re[i], re[j]] = [re[j], re[i]]; [im[i], im[j]] = [im[j], im[i]]; } }
  for (let len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) { const a = -2 * Math.PI / len, wr = Math.cos(a), wi = Math.sin(a); for (let i = 0; i < n; i += len) { let cr = 1, ci = 0; for (let j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) { const ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j], vr = re[i + j + len / 2] * cr - im[i + j + len / 2] * ci, vi = re[i + j + len / 2] * ci + im[i + j + len / 2] * cr; re[i + j] = ur + vr; im[i + j] = ui + vi; re[i + j + len / 2] = ur - vr; im[i + j + len / 2] = ui - vi; const t = cr * wr - ci * wi; ci = cr * wi + ci * wr; cr = t; } } } };
 const EDG = [60, 120, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3500, 5500, 9000, 16000];
 for (const [sc, m, wx] of cases) { const d = await S.render(sc, m, wx, 5, 7); let s2 = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const v = d[i]; if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } s2 += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); }
  const N = 4096, bands = new Float64Array(EDG.length - 1); for (let o = 0; o + N <= d.length; o += N * 2) { const re = new Float64Array(N), im = new Float64Array(N); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) re[i] = d[o + i] * (.5 - .5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / N)); fft(re, im); for (let k = 1; k < N / 2; k++) { const fr = k * 44100 / N; for (let b = 0; b < EDG.length - 1; b++) if (fr >= EDG[b] && fr < EDG[b + 1]) { bands[b] += re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k]; break; } } }
  const tot = bands.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1; out[sc + '|' + m + '|' + wx] = { rms: 20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(s2 / d.length) + 1e-9), pk, nan, bands: Array.from(bands, b => b / tot) }; }
 return out; }'''
INIT = "window.__osc=0;window.__bs=0;const A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(A){const o=A.prototype.createOscillator,b=A.prototype.createBufferSource;A.prototype.createOscillator=function(){window.__osc++;return o.call(this)};A.prototype.createBufferSource=function(){window.__bs++;return b.call(this)};}"
```

```cal148a.py
import sys, os, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async (cases) => {
 const S = window.DL.snd, out = {};
 const fft = (re, im) => { const n = re.length; for (let i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) { let b = n >> 1; for (; j & b; b >>= 1) j ^= b; j ^= b; if (i < j) { [re[i], re[j]] = [re[j], re[i]]; [im[i], im[j]] = [im[j], im[i]]; } }
  for (let len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) { const a = -2 * Math.PI / len, wr = Math.cos(a), wi = Math.sin(a); for (let i = 0; i < n; i += len) { let cr = 1, ci = 0; for (let j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) { const ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j], vr = re[i + j + len / 2] * cr - im[i + j + len / 2] * ci, vi = re[i + j + len / 2] * ci + im[i + j + len / 2] * cr; re[i + j] = ur + vr; im[i + j] = ui + vi; re[i + j + len / 2] = ur - vr; im[i + j + len / 2] = ui - vi; const t = cr * wr - ci * wi; ci = cr * wi + ci * wr; cr = t; } } } };
 const EDG = [60, 120, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3500, 5500, 9000, 16000];
 for (const [sc, m, wx] of cases) {
  const d = await S.render(sc, m, wx, 6, 7); let s2 = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const v = d[i]; if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } s2 += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); }
  const N = 4096, bands = new Float64Array(EDG.length - 1); let wn = 0;
  for (let o = 0; o + N <= d.length; o += N * 2) { const re = new Float64Array(N), im = new Float64Array(N); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) re[i] = d[o + i] * (.5 - .5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / N)); fft(re, im); for (let k = 1; k < N / 2; k++) { const f = k * 44100 / N; for (let b = 0; b < EDG.length - 1; b++) if (f >= EDG[b] && f < EDG[b + 1]) { bands[b] += re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k]; break; } } wn++; }
  const tot = bands.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
  out[sc + '|' + m + '|' + wx] = { rms: +(20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(s2 / d.length) + 1e-9)).toFixed(1), pk: +pk.toFixed(3), nan, bands: Array.from(bands, b => +(b / tot).toFixed(4)) };
 }
 return out; }'''
cases = []
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required']); pg = b.new_page(); errs = []
    pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + f, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    scenes = pg.evaluate("window.DL.snd.scenes()")
    cases = [[s, 780, 'clear'] for s in scenes]
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, cases); b.close()
print('errs', errs)
for k, v in r.items(): print(k.ljust(24), 'rms', v['rms'], 'pk', v['pk'], 'nan', v['nan'], v['bands'])
json.dump(r, open('cal_out.json', 'w'))
```

```mut148a.py
# mut148a.py: mutan cepat suara. Pakai: python3 mut148a.py <v148a.html> [indeks,indeks]  (test148a.py harus ada di folder yang sama)
import sys, subprocess, concurrent.futures as cf, os
src = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read()
M = [
 ('burung malam hidup', "dusk: .55, night: 0 })[ph]", "dusk: .55, night: 1 })[ph]"),
 ('burung tetap saat hujan', "dusk: .55, night: 0 })[ph] * (rain || snow ? 0 :", "dusk: .55, night: 0 })[ph] * (0 ? 0 :"),
 ('volume terlalu keras', "VOL = .34", "VOL = 1.6"),
 ('bawaan menyala', "wantOn = lsGet(SK) === '1'", "wantOn = lsGet(SK) !== '0'"),
 ('tab tersembunyi tetap bersuara', "!document.hidden && homeOpen()", "homeOpen()"),
 ('latar pixel mati tetap bersuara', "&& !pxOff(), now", ", now"),
 ('kunci simpan salah', "SK = 'dailylog:snd:on'", "SK = 'dailylog:snd:zz'"),
 ('tidak pernah suspend', "ctx.suspend(); return; }", "return; }"),
 ('diam tidak menurunkan gain', "setTargetAtTime(ok ? VOL : 0", "setTargetAtTime(ok ? VOL : VOL"),
 ('jam senja = siang', "m < 1140 ? 'dusk'", "m < 1140 ? 'day'"),
 ('jam fajar = siang', "m < 450 ? 'dawn'", "m < 450 ? 'day'"),
]
def run(i):
    n, a, b = M[i]
    if src.count(a) != 1: return (n, 'SALAH-UJI (pola ditemukan %d kali)' % src.count(a))
    d = '/tmp/m148_%d' % i; os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    open(d + '/m.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(src.replace(a, b))
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'test148a.py', d + '/m.html', 'cepat'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=400)
    gagal = [l.split()[1] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('GAGAL') or l.startswith('FAIL')]
    v = 'TERTANGKAP' if 'VONIS: GAGAL' in r.stdout or r.returncode != 0 else 'LOLOS (mutan hidup!)'
    return (n, v + ' ' + ','.join(gagal))
with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(5) as ex:
    idx = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else range(len(M))
    res = list(ex.map(run, idx))
hid = 0
for n, v in res:
    print(n.ljust(48), v)
    if v.startswith('LOLOS') or v.startswith('SALAH'): hid += 1
print('MUTAN HIDUP/SALAH:', hid, 'dari', len(M))
```

## ALAT UJI ADEGAN CERMIN 148b (disimpan supaya tidak hilang; kode adegan = fungsi `CERMIN` di daily-log.html, penanda `/* ===== v148b: adegan ke-18` ... `/* ===== /v148b adegan cermin ===== */`; resep suara = baris `cermin(c)` di tabel `SND`, nilai `cermin` di `CAL`)
**Pakai:** `python3 audit-adegan.py <html>` (sudah memuat `cermin`), `python3 sweep148b.py <html>`, `python3 fxproof148b.py <html>`, `python3 ftime148b.py <html> gerbang,kapal,cermin`, `python3 shot1.py <html> <png> "cermin:780:clear:1;cermin:1320:clear:3"`, `python3 test148a.py <html> cepat`, `python3 cal148a.py <html>`. `patch148b.py` memasang fungsi adegan dari berkas js (ekstrak fungsi `CERMIN` dari html bila perlu).
```patch148b.py
# patch148b.py: pasang adegan ke-18 `cermin` + resep suara. Pakai: python3 patch148b.py in.html cermin148.js out.html [kal]   (kal = nilai CAL, bawaan 1)
import sys
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); g = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read(); K = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else '1'
def rep(old, new, cnt=1):
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == cnt, (old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
rep("  const SCN = ['airterjun',", g + "  const SCN = ['airterjun',")
rep("'embun', 'mercu', 'kapal', 'gerbang'];", "'embun', 'mercu', 'kapal', 'gerbang', 'cermin'];")
rep("o.scene === 'gerbang' ? GERBANG(o) :", "o.scene === 'gerbang' ? GERBANG(o) : o.scene === 'cermin' ? CERMIN(o) :")
SND = "    cermin(c) { c.b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 520, q: .9, g: .1, lfo: [.09, .45] }).b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 200, g: .12 }).b({ o: 'sine', f: 110, ft: 'lowpass', hz: 300, g: .012, lfo: [.07, .4] }); c.wind(.07, 480); c.birds(.12, 3000); c.bugs(.9, 4300); c.frogs(.5); c.owl(.03); c.e({ k: 'bubble', r: .5, g: .04, lp: 1500 }).e({ k: 'bell', r: .006, g: .05, f: 420, lp: 1800 }); },\n"
rep("  };\n  const CAL = {", SND + "  };\n  const CAL = {")
rep("gerbang: .38 };", "gerbang: .38, cermin: " + K + " };")
open(sys.argv[3], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))
```
```sweep148b.py
# sweep147b.py: sapuan adegan cermin x 7 jam x 7 cuaca x 3 seed (390x274 dan 195x137), cek galat, NaN, kecerahan. Pakai: python3 sweep147b.py <berkas.html>
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, res = { n: 0, errs: [], dark: [], bright: [] };
 for (const [W, H] of [[390, 274], [195, 137]]) for (const mn of [330, 420, 600, 780, 960, 1090, 1320]) for (const wx of ['clear','few','cloud','fog','rain','storm','snow']) for (const sd of [1, 2, 3]) {
  try { const e = PX.create({ scene: 'cermin', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); let s = 0; for (const t of [0, .7, 1.9, 4.2]) e.frame(t, o);
   for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) { const c = o[i]; s += (c & 255) + ((c >> 8) & 255) + ((c >> 16) & 255); if ((c >>> 24) !== 255) { res.errs.push('alfa ' + W + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx); break; } }
   const m = s / (o.length * 3); res.n++; if (m < 6) res.dark.push([W, mn, wx, sd, +m.toFixed(1)]); if (m > 170) res.bright.push([W, mn, wx, sd, +m.toFixed(1)]);
  } catch (er) { res.errs.push(W + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx + ' ' + sd + ': ' + er.message); } }
 return res; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200); r = pg.evaluate(JS); b.close()
print('kombinasi', r['n'], 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr), 'terlalu gelap', len(r['dark']), 'terlalu terang', len(r['bright']))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
print('gelap contoh', r['dark'][:4]); print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not r['errs'] and not perr and not r['dark'] and not r['bright'] else 'GAGAL')
```
```fxproof148b.py
# fxproof148b.py: bukti efek dengan/tanpa (nofx) adegan cermin, persen piksel berubah + rasio kecerahan. Pakai: python3 fxproof148b.py <berkas.html>
import sys, os, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, out = {};
 const mk = (nf, mn, wx, csh) => { const e = PX.create({ scene: 'cermin', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: 2, nofx: nf, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0, .7, 1.9]) e.frame(t, o); return o; };
 const lum = o => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) { const c = o[i]; s += (c & 255) + ((c >> 8) & 255) + ((c >> 16) & 255); } return s / (o.length * 3); };
 for (const [fx, mn, wx] of [['shafts', 960, 'clear'], ['shafts', 1320, 'clear'], ['bloom', 780, 'clear'], ['bloom', 1320, 'clear'], ['dof', 780, 'clear'], ['rim', 780, 'clear'], ['ambient', 780, 'clear'], ['ambient', 1320, 'clear'], ['glit', 780, 'clear'], ['aoc', 780, 'clear']]) { const a = mk([], mn, wx), b = mk([fx], mn, wx); let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) d++; out[fx + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx] = [+(100 * d / a.length).toFixed(2), +(lum(a) / lum(b)).toFixed(3)]; }
 for (const [mn, wx] of [[780, 'clear'], [960, 'clear']]) { const a = mk([], mn, wx, undefined), b = mk([], mn, wx, 0); let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) d++; out['bayangan-jatuh ' + mn + ' ' + wx] = [+(100 * d / a.length).toFixed(2), +(lum(a) / lum(b)).toFixed(3)]; }
 return out; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS)
    for k, v in r.items(): print(k.ljust(28), 'piksel berubah %', v[0], ' rasio terang', v[1])
    b.close()
```
```ftime148b.py
# ftime148b.py: waktu bingkai rata-rata (ms) adegan di Chromium. Pakai: python3 ftime148b.py <berkas.html> [adegan,adegan]
import sys, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async (sc) => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, r = {}; for (const s of sc) for (const [mn, wx] of [[780,'clear'],[1320,'clear'],[960,'storm']]) { const e = PX.create({ scene: s, W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: 2 }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); e.frame(0, o); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let k = 1; k <= 20; k++) e.frame(k * .1, o); r[s + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx] = +((performance.now() - t0) / 20).toFixed(1); } return r; }'''
sc = (sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'gerbang,cermin').split(',')
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    for k, v in pg.evaluate(JS, sc).items(): print(k.ljust(24), v, 'ms/bingkai')
    b.close()
```

#### 148b (5 Nov 2026): ADEGAN KE-18 `cermin` SELESAI dan LULUS uji; `daily-log.html` = v148b
- **Tema (dari `pilih-tema.js` seed 148, TIDAK dipilih sendiri; dicatat ke RIWAYAT-TEMA dengan `--catat cermin`):** genre = novel fantasi epik (menara penyihir); POV = cermin/pantulan; palet = hijau toksik; suasana = damai. **Subjek yang saya pilih (orisinal):** menara penyihir miring di pulau karang tengah danau hijau racun yang tenang seperti cermin; setengah bingkai bawah adalah PANTULAN nyata (cermin terhadap garis air tiap kolom: langit, bukit, pulau, menara, kristal, matahari/bulan, burung); seorang penyihir muda berjubah dan bertopi runcing di perahu kecil berlentera, deretan lentera air menuntun ke menara, spora hijau melayang.
- **Kode (`patch148b.py`; v148a -> v148b):** fungsi `CERMIN(o)` (sekitar 34 KB) disisipkan sebelum `SCN`; `SCN` + `'cermin'`; `create0` + cabang `cermin`; resep suara `cermin(c)` di `SND` + `cermin: 1.7` di `CAL` (kalibrasi `cal148a.py`: dari -36,7 ke sekitar -32 dBFS, setara adegan lain). Mesin lain TIDAK diubah.
- **Perspektif dan cermin (butir 3):** cakrawala di 40 persen tinggi; air memantulkan dengan model nyata: baris sumber = 2 x garis air kolom - baris sekarang (pulau memakai garis airnya sendiri, bukit dan langit memakai cakrawala), pantulan makin kuat dekat cakrawala dan makin lemah dekat kamera (kira-kira Fresnel), diwarnai hijau karena air menyerap merah dan biru, dibelokkan riak (gelombang makin besar ke dekat kamera dan makin kasar saat hujan/badai); riak hujan dan ikan berbentuk elips dengan rasio tinggi:lebar naik dari 0,1 (jauh) ke 0,48 (dekat); lentera dan perahu mengecil menurut jarak ke cakrawala.
- **Tiga bidang (butir 12):** BACKGROUND = langit hijau-kuning berawan bergerak, dua lapis bukit berkabut, menara jauh di kabut; MIDDLEGROUND = pulau karang + menara penyihir miring di sepertiga kanan atau kiri (acak per seed), pohon cemara kecil, perahu, lentera air; FOREGROUND = karang pojok gelap, pohon bengkok berdaun lebat, jamur menyala, alang-alang tajam dan buram (DOF), sulur bergoyang. Tiap bidang berbeda nilai terang (jauh paling pucat, depan paling gelap dan memotong tepi).
- **Jam dan cuaca:** matahari/bulan mengikuti jam (halo, piringan, bulan dengan maria, berkas cahaya renggang di langit); jendela dan kristal menyala makin gelap makin terang, kristal berdenyut dan memancarkan suar tipis saat gelap atau mendung; bintang dan kunang-kunang malam; cerah = pantulan tajam dan kilau di jalur matahari, mendung = awan tebal dan cahaya arah hilang, kabut = pita kabut tebal, hujan = tetes 3D dengan riak elips dan air kasar, badai = air sangat kasar, hujan miring, kilat, salju = serpihan.
- **Bayangan (butir 17):** menara, tiga pohon pulau (batu pulau menangkap bayangan siluet, `shCast` + `shAO`), pohon depan (jatuh di karang depan) memakai `shPar`/`shDir`/`shSil`/`shCast`/`shAO`, arah menjauhi matahari menurut posisi benda; oklusi ambien di pangkal benda, bawah balkon, bawah tepi topi, garis air pulau. `CS`, `CS.sx` diekspos; `o.csh = 0` mematikan bayangan.
- **Tokoh acak bebas (butir 14, dipilih acak per seed lewat hash 32 bit):** perahu dengan penyihir muda dan lentera (80 persen), burung terbang siang atau burung hantu malam (85 persen, pantulannya ikut), riak ikan melompat (70 persen, tidak saat hujan). Tokoh perahu berdetail (jubah, topi runcing, wajah, tongkat berkristal menyala, lentera busur) dan punya pantulan; bayangan KONTAK di dek perahu selalu ada (butir 16; bayangan jatuh tidak di air sesuai butir 16b).
- **Uji (Chromium nyata, halaman asli, 0 galat halaman):** (1) `audit-adegan.py` 13 adegan x 2 jam x 2 cuaca x 1 seed = 52 kombinasi, 0 galat, VONIS LULUS; cermin: cerah ch min 1,37 persen (med 1,61), arah salah 0, piksel bayangan di atas cakrawala 0, mendung/hujan min 1451 piksel berubah (oklusi ambien); adegan lain tidak berubah. (2) `sweep148b.py` 294 kombinasi (2 ukuran x 7 jam x 7 cuaca x 3 seed), 0 galat, tidak ada bingkai terlalu gelap atau terlalu terang. (3) Efek dengan/tanpa (`fxproof148b.py`, persen piksel berubah dan rasio terang): berkas langit 17,85 (senja) dan 11,07 (malam, berkas bulan); bloom siang 23,67 dan malam 19,49; DOF alang-alang 2,09; cahaya tepi 6,12; ambient (spora dan kabut pulau) 6,10 siang dan 7,93 malam; kilau air 1,33; oklusi garis air 0,83; bayangan jatuh 1,80 (siang) dan 1,99 (senja); rasio kecerahan 0,997 sampai 1,091 (tidak turun drastis). (4) Tangkapan 390x274 DILIHAT: siang, senja, malam, hujan, kabut, salju, badai, fajar (8 kondisi) lalu siang, senja, malam, hujan lagi setelah perbaikan akhir. (5) Suara: `test148a.py cepat` LULUS dengan 18 resep (A1 diubah ke 18; A4 unik 18/18; B4 jarak spektrum antar adegan tetap >= 0,08). (6) Waktu bingkai (Chromium desktop, `ftime148b.py`): sebelum optimasi 27 sampai 38 ms, sesudah (awan per blok 2x2, berkas langit statis) 21 sampai 33 ms; gerbang 18 sampai 20 ms, kapal 17 sampai 25 ms.

- **Alat baru `refl149.py` (uji pantulan; kodenya disimpan di bagian ALAT UJI 149a di bawah):** metrik = KONTRAS PANTULAN MENARA, yaitu selisih mutlak rata-rata luminans air di bawah menara (kolom sumbu menara +-3, baris cakrawala+30 sampai +90) terhadap air di kiri dan kanan jauh (+-45 sampai 70 piksel) pada baris yang sama; ambang >= 8,0 pada cerah/sedikit awan. Nilai terukur: asli 33,9 sampai 49,1 siang, 42,1 senja, 10,5 malam (cerah, terendah); mutan R1 maksimal 4,9 (malam) dan 0,5 sampai 3,0 siang; mutan R2 0,7 sampai 3,9. **Jujur soal proses:** (1) metrik pertama saya (korelasi Pearson baris air terhadap baris cermin) GAGAL pada versi ASLI (0,28 melawan kontrol 0,44) karena korelasi mentah didominasi gradien terang vertikal, jadi metriknya yang salah, bukan adegannya, dan saya buang; (2) metrik kedua sempat memilih benda `pohonDepan` (foreground, memang tidak ikut terpantul) sehingga hasilnya acak; saya ganti ke `menara`; (3) AMBANG 8,0 saya tetapkan SETELAH melihat angka asli dan mutan (margin: asli minimal 10,5, mutan maksimal 4,9), jadi ini uji deteksi mutan dengan margin, bukan uji independen; margin malam hari sempit (10,5 melawan 8,0).

## ALAT UJI 149a (6 Nov 2026; disimpan supaya tidak hilang antar sesi; ekstrak dengan pola yang sama seperti alat lain)
```refl149.py
# refl149.py (Tahap 149a): uji PANTULAN adegan cermin di Chromium nyata. Pakai: python3 refl149.py <berkas.html> [angka]
# Metrik: KONTRAS PANTULAN MENARA = selisih mutlak rata-rata luminans air tepat di bawah menara pulau (kolom cxo +-3, baris hy+30..hy+90)
# terhadap air di kiri/kanan jauh (cxo +-(45..70)) pada baris yang sama. Air tanpa pantulan benda: kontras ~ 0; dengan pantulan benda tegak: kontras jelas.
import sys, os, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, out = [];
 const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
 for (const [mn, wx, sd] of [[780,'clear',1],[780,'clear',2],[780,'clear',4],[960,'clear',3],[600,'few',5],[1320,'clear',1],[780,'cloud',2]]) {
  const e = PX.create({ scene: 'cermin', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0, .7]) e.frame(t, o);
  const T = e.cs.filter(c => c.nm === 'menara')[0]; if (!T) { out.push({ mn, wx, sd, none: 1 }); continue; } const hy = e.zone.hy;
  let a = 0, an = 0, b = 0, bn = 0; const y0 = hy + 30, y1 = Math.min(H - 2, hy + 90);
  for (let y = y0; y <= y1 && y < H; y++) { for (let x = Math.round(T.x) - 3; x <= Math.round(T.x) + 3; x++) if (x >= 0 && x < W) { a += lum(o[y*W+x]); an++; }
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) for (let d = 45; d <= 70; d++) { const x = Math.round(T.x) + s * d; if (x >= 0 && x < W) { b += lum(o[y*W+x]); bn++; } } }
  out.push({ mn, wx, sd, nm: T.nm, x: Math.round(T.x), by: T.by, hmax: T.hmax, kontras: bn && an ? +Math.abs(a/an - b/bn).toFixed(1) : -1, rows: y1 - y0 + 1 }); }
 return out; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200); r = pg.evaluate(JS); b.close()
for x in r: print(x)
TH = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 8.0
ok = all(x.get('kontras', 0) >= TH for x in r if x['wx'] in ('clear', 'few') and not x.get('none'))
print('galat halaman', len(perr)); print('VONIS-PANTULAN:', 'LULUS' if ok and not perr else 'GAGAL', '(ambang kontras >= %s pada cerah/sedikit awan)' % TH)
```

```mut149a.py
# mut149a.py (Tahap 149a): mutan cepat adegan cermin. audit-adegan.py dan refl149.py harus ada di folder yang sama. Pakai: python3 mut149a.py <berkas.html>
import subprocess, sys, os
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))
a = base.index('/* ===== v148b: adegan ke-18'); b = base.index('/* ===== /v148b adegan cermin ===== */'); blk = base[a:b]
def run(p, kind):
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'audit-adegan.py' if kind == 'audit' else 'refl149.py', p] + (['ringkas'] if kind == 'audit' else []), capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=D)
    v = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('VONIS')]; return v[0] if v else (r.stdout[-300:] + r.stderr[-300:])
def job(name, kind, pairs):
    s = blk
    for old, new, cnt in pairs:
        assert s.count(old) == cnt, (name, old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
    p = os.path.join(D, 'mut_%s.html' % name); open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(base[:a] + s + base[b:]); v = run(p, kind); os.remove(p)
    return name, ('TERTANGKAP' if 'GAGAL' in v and (kind == 'refl' or 'cermin' in v) else 'LOLOS (BURUK)') + ' | ' + v[:170]
J = [
 ('C1_bayangan_mati', 'audit', [("CS = [], CSH = o.csh !== 0; CS.sx = sxw", "CS = [], CSH = false; CS.sx = sxw", 1)]),
 ('C2_arah_dibalik', 'audit', [("d_.dxr *= .55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", "d_.dxr *= -.55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", 1)]),
 ('C3_bayangan_di_langit', 'audit', [("ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y > hy && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", "ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H;", 1)]),
 ('C4_oklusi_dibuang', 'audit', [("ao = shAO(W, H, cxo, ob.by + 1, rxA, clamp(rxA * .22, 2, 5), .46, ok_, dk_, shm);", "ao = 0;", 1), ("ao = shAO(W, H, tbx, by + 1, rxA, I(3), .5, ok_, dk_, sh2);", "ao = 0;", 1)]),
 ('R1_pantulan_tanpa_cermin', 'refl', [("sy = Math.round(2 * m - y + dyw)", "sy = Math.round(y + dyw)", 1)]),
 ('R2_pantulan_nol', 'refl', [("rf0 = (.94 - .52 * Math.pow(q, .75)) * (1 - .3 * Math.min(1, rg / 3))", "rf0 = 0", 1)]),
]
print('asli audit  ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'audit')); print('asli pantulan ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'refl'))
with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
    for name, res in ex.map(lambda j: job(*j), J): print(name.ljust(26), '->', res)
```

#### 149b (6 Nov 2026): OKLUSI PANGKAL MENARA `cermin` diperbaiki; `daily-log.html` = v149b
- **Temuan dan sebab (dari 149a):** `menara.ao` = 0 di semua seed. Syarat `y > hy` pada `ok_` bayangan pulau menolak seluruh dataran batu di atas cakrawala (pangkal menara di baris 101, cakrawala 110), padahal topeng batu `gm` sudah membatasi bayangan hanya pada batu.
- **Kode (`patch149b.py`; v148b -> v149b, hanya blok `CERMIN`):** (1) `ok_` pulau jadi `y >= 0 && y < H && gm[...] === 1` (syarat cakrawala dibuang); (2) `rock: gm` diekspos di objek adegan. **Audit diperketat (`audit-adegan.py`):** "piksel di langit" untuk `cermin` kini = piksel berubah di atas cakrawala yang BUKAN batu (`e.rock`), dan baris baru `cermin:menara tanpa oklusi pangkal` bila `menara.ao == 0`.
- **Hasil terukur:** `menara.ao` 0 -> 81 sampai 125 piksel; bayangan jatuh menara 342 sampai 469 -> 651 sampai 780 piksel (kini jatuh juga di dataran batu); bayangan jatuh 1,80 -> 2,63 persen piksel (`fxproof148b.py`). Audit 52 kombinasi 0 galat VONIS LULUS (cermin cerah ch min 1,37 -> 2,28); sapuan 294 kombinasi 0 galat tidak terlalu gelap/terang; efek lain tidak berubah (bloom 23,67/19,5; DOF 2,09; cahaya tepi 6,12; ambient 6,10/7,93; kilau 1,33; oklusi garis air 0,83); `refl149.py` LULUS (asli 10,5 sampai 49,1). **Mutan ulang pada v149b: 7 dari 7 TERTANGKAP** (C1 sampai C4, C5 syarat cakrawala lama = tertangkap oleh pemeriksaan menara baru, R1, R2). Tangkapan 390x274 DILIHAT: siang (2 seed), malam, hujan, kabut senja, fajar; tidak ada artefak baru.
- **Jujur:** (1) `pohonP1`/`pohonP2` masih sering `ao` 0 sampai 1 (pangkal di tepi batu); audit hanya memeriksa menara per benda, belum pohon pulau; (2) bentuk pulau masih tampak seperti lempeng batu bertekstur dan menara jauh seperti batang pucat (utang butir 4 di BELUM 148b) BELUM dirapikan; (3) mutan di latar belakang (`nohup`) sempat mati tanpa hasil dan diulang di latar depan.
- **Pemeriksaan aturan adegan (149b, perbaikan adegan):** [1 satu adegan baru: dikerjakan di 149c] [3,12 tidak berubah] [8 bayangan jatuh ada + bukti (2,63); oklusi ambien ada + bukti (menara 81 sampai 125 piksel; garis air 0,83)] [17 bayangan benda statis: menara kini lulus, pohon pulau belum diaudit per benda] [18 tidak berubah]. Nama dan sumber tidak disebut di obrolan.

```patch149b.py
# patch149b.py (Tahap 149b): oklusi pangkal menara + bayangan menara di dataran batu pulau (di atas cakrawala), topeng batu diekspos. Pakai: python3 patch149b.py in.html out.html
import sys
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read()
a = s.index('/* ===== v148b: adegan ke-18'); b = s.index('/* ===== /v148b adegan cermin ===== */'); blk = s[a:b]
def rep(old, new):
    global blk
    assert blk.count(old) == 1, (old[:60], blk.count(old)); blk = blk.replace(old, new)
rep("ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y > hy && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", "ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;")
```

```audit-adegan.py
# audit-adegan.py (Tahap 147a; diperketat 149b: cermin memakai topeng batu `e.rock` untuk 'bukan langit' dan menara wajib punya oklusi pangkal): audit pra-adegan bayangan benda statis, SEMUA adegan, Chromium nyata.
# Pakai: python3 audit-adegan.py <berkas.html> [ringkas]   -> mencetak tabel + VONIS
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SMALL = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = r'''
async (cfg) => {
  const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, rows = [], errs = [];
  const NAT = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan'];
  const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
  for (const sc of cfg.scenes) for (const [hn, mn] of cfg.hours) for (const wx of cfg.wxs) for (const sd of cfg.seeds) {
    try {
      const mk = csh => { const e = PX.create({ scene: sc, W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0,.5,1]) e.frame(t,o); return [e,o]; };
      const [e1,o1] = mk(undefined), [e0,o0] = mk(0);
      let ch = 0, drop = 0, sky = 0; const LY = e1.lay; for (let i = 0; i < o1.length; i++) if (o1[i] !== o0[i]) { ch++; drop += lum(o0[i]) - lum(o1[i]); if (LY && NAT.includes(sc) && LY[i] === 0) sky++; else if (['mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin'].includes(sc) && e1.zone && ((i / W) | 0) <= e1.zone.hy && !(sc === 'cermin' && e1.rock && e1.rock[i] === 1)) sky++; }
      const cs = e1.cs || []; let sx = cs.sx; const sunU = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mn - 330)/800));
      if (sx == null) sx = (.14 + .72*sunU)*W;
      let dirBad = 0, nObj = 0, spSum = 0;
      for (const c of cs) { nObj++; spSum += c.sp||0; const side = sx - c.x; if ((c.sp||0) > 40 && Math.abs(side) > 8 && ((side > 0 && c.dxr > 0) || (side < 0 && c.dxr < 0))) dirBad++; }
      const mnr = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'menara'); rows.push({ sc, hn, wx, sd, menaraAo: mnr ? mnr.ao : -1, ch, pct: +(100*ch/(W*H)).toFixed(3), mdrop: ch ? +(drop/ch).toFixed(1) : 0, nObj, spSum, dirBad, sky, aoSum: cs.reduce((t, c) => t + (c.ao || 0), 0) });
    } catch (err) { errs.push(sc+' '+hn+' '+wx+' '+sd+': '+err.message); }
  }
  return { rows, errs };
}'''
scenes = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','atap','mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin']
cfg = dict(scenes=scenes, hours=[[7,420],[10,600],[13,780],[16,960]] if not SMALL else [[7,420],[13,780]],
           wxs=['clear','few','cloud','rain'] if not SMALL else ['clear','rain'], seeds=[1,2] if not SMALL else [1])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':780})
    perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://'+os.path.abspath(f), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, cfg); b.close()
rows = r['rows']; print('kombinasi', len(rows), 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
why = []
print('adegan       | cerah ch% min/med | selisih terang rata2 (cerah) | mendung-hujan ch min | arahSalah | piksel di langit')
for sc in scenes:
    R = [x for x in rows if x['sc'] == sc]; sun = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('clear','few')]
    bad = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('cloud','rain')]
    pcts = sorted(x['pct'] for x in sun) or [0]; md = sorted(x['mdrop'] for x in sun) or [0]
    bmin = min([x['ch'] for x in bad] or [0]); db = sum(x['dirBad'] for x in R); sk = sum(x['sky'] for x in R)
    print(f"{sc:12s} | {pcts[0]:.2f} / {pcts[len(pcts)//2]:.2f}        | {md[len(md)//2]:5.1f} (min {md[0]:.1f})          | {bmin:6d}               | {db} | {sk}")
    if pcts[0] < (.25 if sc == 'mercu' else .5): why.append(sc+':cerah ch<0.5%')
    if db: why.append(sc+':arah salah')
    if sk: why.append(sc+':bayangan di langit')
    if bmin == 0: why.append(sc+':mendung tanpa oklusi')
    if sc == 'cermin' and any(x['menaraAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('cermin:menara tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc in ('airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','gerbang','cermin') and any(x['aoSum'] == 0 for x in R): why.append(sc+':oklusi ambien nol')
json.dump(r, open('/tmp/audit_'+os.path.basename(f)+'.json','w'))
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not why else 'GAGAL ('+'; '.join(why)+')')
```

```mut149a.py
        assert s.count(old) == cnt, (name, old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
    p = os.path.join(D, 'mut_%s.html' % name); open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(base[:a] + s + base[b:]); v = run(p, kind); os.remove(p)
    return name, ('TERTANGKAP' if 'GAGAL' in v and (kind == 'refl' or 'cermin' in v) else 'LOLOS (BURUK)') + ' | ' + v[:170]
J = [
 ('C1_bayangan_mati', 'audit', [("CS = [], CSH = o.csh !== 0; CS.sx = sxw", "CS = [], CSH = false; CS.sx = sxw", 1)]),
 ('C2_arah_dibalik', 'audit', [("d_.dxr *= .55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", "d_.dxr *= -.55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", 1)]),
 ('C3_bayangan_di_langit', 'audit', [("ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", "ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H;", 1)]),
 ('C4_oklusi_dibuang', 'audit', [("ao = shAO(W, H, cxo, ob.by + 1, rxA, clamp(rxA * .22, 2, 5), .46, ok_, dk_, shm);", "ao = 0;", 1), ("ao = shAO(W, H, tbx, by + 1, rxA, I(3), .5, ok_, dk_, sh2);", "ao = 0;", 1)]),
 ('C5_syarat_cakrawala_lama', 'audit', [("ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", "ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y > hy && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", 1)]),
 ('R1_pantulan_tanpa_cermin', 'refl', [("sy = Math.round(2 * m - y + dyw)", "sy = Math.round(y + dyw)", 1)]),
 ('R2_pantulan_nol', 'refl', [("rf0 = (.94 - .52 * Math.pow(q, .75)) * (1 - .3 * Math.min(1, rg / 3))", "rf0 = 0", 1)]),
]
print('asli audit  ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'audit')); print('asli pantulan ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'refl'))
with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
    for name, res in ex.map(lambda j: job(*j), J): print(name.ljust(26), '->', res)
```

```patch150a.py
# patch150a.py: pasang adegan ke-19 `siluet` + resep suara. Pakai: python3 patch150a.py in.html siluet150.js out.html [kal]   (kal = nilai CAL, bawaan 1)
import sys
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); g = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read(); K = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else '1'
def rep(old, new, cnt=1):
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == cnt, (old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
rep("  const SCN = ['airterjun',", g + "  const SCN = ['airterjun',")
rep("'embun', 'mercu', 'kapal', 'gerbang', 'cermin'];", "'embun', 'mercu', 'kapal', 'gerbang', 'cermin', 'siluet'];")
rep("o.scene === 'cermin' ? CERMIN(o) :", "o.scene === 'cermin' ? CERMIN(o) : o.scene === 'siluet' ? SILUET(o) :")
SND = "    siluet(c) { c.b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 380, g: .3, lfo: [.1, .7] }).b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 1600, q: .5, g: .04, lfo: [.12, .8] }).b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 140, g: .12, lfo: [.06, .5] }); c.wind(.12, 520); c.gulls(.08); c.birds(.1, 3400); c.bugs(.7, 4400); c.e({ k: 'bell', r: .01, g: .035, f: 1040, lp: 3200 }); },\n"
rep("  };\n  const CAL = {", SND + "  };\n  const CAL = {")
rep("cermin: 1.7 };", "cermin: 1.7, siluet: " + K + " };")
open(sys.argv[3], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))
```

**Pakai:** ekstrak dengan pola 147a (`python3 -I -c 'import re;s=open("PROGRESS-2.md",encoding="utf-8").read();d={};[d.__setitem__(n,b) for n,b in re.findall(r"`{3}([\w.\-]+\.(?:py|js|sh|json|mjs))\n(.*?)\n`{3}",s,re.S)];[open(n,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(b) for n,b in d.items()]'`). `python3 patch151a.py v150a.html v151a.html 1` (v150a -> v151a), `python3 audit-adegan.py <html> [ringkas]` (14 adegan), `python3 refl151.py <html>`, `python3 seam151.py <html>`, `python3 mut151a.py <html> [indeks,indeks]` (7 mutan siluet), `python3 test148a.py <html> [cepat]` (A1 kini 19 adegan). `sweep150a.py` dan `fxproof150a.py` = `sweep148b.py` dan `fxproof148b.py` dengan `sed "s/'cermin'/'siluet'/g"`.
```patch151a.py
# patch151a.py (Tahap 151a): perbaikan adegan `siluet` v150a -> v151a. Pakai: python3 patch151a.py in.html out.html [kal]
import sys
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); K = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else '1'
a = s.index('/* ===== v150a: adegan ke-19'); b = s.index('/* ===== /v150a adegan siluet ===== */'); blk = s[a:b]
def rep(old, new, cnt=1):
    global blk
    assert blk.count(old) == cnt, (old[:70], blk.count(old)); blk = blk.replace(old, new)
# 1. garis sambungan awan: tanda arah (-1/+1) melompat tepat di x matahari -> ganti dengan transisi halus
rep("for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 2) {\n        const fx = x * .016", "for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 2) {\n        const sgx = -clamp((x - sxw) / (W * .12), -1, 1);\n        const fx = x * .016")
rep("(sxw < x ? -1 : 1)", "sgx", 2)
# 2. rumput buram (DOF): bilah meruncing, bengkok, tepi gauss (bukan kolom persegi)
rep("for (let k = 0; k < r.h * 1.2; k++) { const f = k / (r.h * 1.2); px = r.x + sw * f * f + inw * f * I(2); py = r.y - k; for (let dx = -I(1.6); dx <= I(1.6); dx++) Bd(out, px + dx, py, 4, 14, 20, .22); } continue; }",
    "const hb_ = r.h * 1.2, w0 = I(1.5) + .6; for (let k = 0; k < hb_; k++) { const f = k / hb_; px = r.x + sw * f * f + inw * f * I(2); py = r.y - k; const wk = Math.max(.5, w0 * (1 - .85 * f)); for (let dx = -Math.ceil(wk + 1); dx <= Math.ceil(wk + 1); dx++) { const g_ = Math.exp(-(dx * dx) / (wk * wk * .9 + .3)); if (g_ > .08) Bd(out, px + dx, py, 5, 17, 23, .5 * g_ * (1 - .45 * f)); } } continue; }")
# 3. pelepah depan: sirip tiap langkah (bukan tiap dua), supaya rapat dan bukan jaring
rep("if (r % 2 === 0 && q > .08) {", "if (q > .08) {")
# 5. topeng lm ikut dikembalikan (untuk audit: bayangan tidak boleh jatuh di benda lain)
rep("zone: { hy, wl: hy, sx: sxw }, rock: gm,", "zone: { hy, wl: hy, sx: sxw }, rock: gm, lmask: lm,")
s = s[:a] + blk + s[b:]
def rs(old, new):
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (old[:70], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
# 4. suara: geser energi dari <500 Hz ke 500-3500 Hz (riak air dan percikan) supaya beda dari atap dan mercu
rs("siluet(c) { c.b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 380, g: .3, lfo: [.1, .7] }).b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 1600, q: .5, g: .04, lfo: [.12, .8] }).b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 140, g: .12, lfo: [.06, .5] });",
   "siluet(c) { c.b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 300, g: .16, lfo: [.1, .7] }).b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 760, q: .7, g: .13, lfo: [.13, .8] }).b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 2400, q: .8, g: .07, lfo: [.17, .9] }).b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 140, g: .05, lfo: [.06, .5] });")
rs("cermin: 1.7, siluet: 1 };", "cermin: 1.7, siluet: " + K + " };")
open(sys.argv[2], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))
```
```audit-adegan.py
# audit-adegan.py (Tahap 147a; 151a2: siluet juga diperiksa 'bayangan tidak jatuh di benda lain' lewat e.lmask; 151a: memuat adegan `siluet` (langit bukan batu = bukan gm, pohon wajib punya oklusi pangkal); diperketat 149b: cermin memakai topeng batu `e.rock` untuk 'bukan langit' dan menara wajib punya oklusi pangkal): audit pra-adegan bayangan benda statis, SEMUA adegan, Chromium nyata.
# Pakai: python3 audit-adegan.py <berkas.html> [ringkas]   -> mencetak tabel + VONIS
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SMALL = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = r'''
async (cfg) => {
  const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, rows = [], errs = [];
  const NAT = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan'];
  const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
  for (const sc of cfg.scenes) for (const [hn, mn] of cfg.hours) for (const wx of cfg.wxs) for (const sd of cfg.seeds) {
    try {
      const mk = csh => { const e = PX.create({ scene: sc, W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0,.5,1]) e.frame(t,o); return [e,o]; };
      const [e1,o1] = mk(undefined), [e0,o0] = mk(0);
      let ch = 0, drop = 0, sky = 0, objSh = 0; const LY = e1.lay; for (let i = 0; i < o1.length; i++) if (o1[i] !== o0[i]) { ch++; if (sc === 'siluet' && e1.lmask && e1.lmask[i] === 2 && e1.rock[i] !== 1) objSh++; drop += lum(o0[i]) - lum(o1[i]); if (LY && NAT.includes(sc) && LY[i] === 0) sky++; else if (['mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet'].includes(sc) && e1.zone && ((i / W) | 0) <= e1.zone.hy && !((sc === 'cermin' || sc === 'siluet') && e1.rock && e1.rock[i] === 1)) sky++; }
      const cs = e1.cs || []; let sx = cs.sx; const sunU = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mn - 330)/800));
      if (sx == null) sx = (.14 + .72*sunU)*W;
      let dirBad = 0, nObj = 0, spSum = 0;
      for (const c of cs) { nObj++; spSum += c.sp||0; const side = sx - c.x; if ((c.sp||0) > 40 && Math.abs(side) > 8 && ((side > 0 && c.dxr > 0) || (side < 0 && c.dxr < 0))) dirBad++; }
      const mnr = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'menara'), phn = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'pohon'); rows.push({ sc, hn, wx, sd, menaraAo: mnr ? mnr.ao : -1, pohonAo: phn ? phn.ao : -1, objSh, ch, pct: +(100*ch/(W*H)).toFixed(3), mdrop: ch ? +(drop/ch).toFixed(1) : 0, nObj, spSum, dirBad, sky, aoSum: cs.reduce((t, c) => t + (c.ao || 0), 0) });
    } catch (err) { errs.push(sc+' '+hn+' '+wx+' '+sd+': '+err.message); }
  }
  return { rows, errs };
}'''
scenes = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','atap','mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet']
cfg = dict(scenes=scenes, hours=[[7,420],[10,600],[13,780],[16,960]] if not SMALL else [[7,420],[13,780]],
           wxs=['clear','few','cloud','rain'] if not SMALL else ['clear','rain'], seeds=[1,2] if not SMALL else [1])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':780})
    perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://'+os.path.abspath(f), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, cfg); b.close()
rows = r['rows']; print('kombinasi', len(rows), 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
why = []
print('adegan       | cerah ch% min/med | selisih terang rata2 (cerah) | mendung-hujan ch min | arahSalah | piksel di langit')
for sc in scenes:
    R = [x for x in rows if x['sc'] == sc]; sun = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('clear','few')]
    bad = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('cloud','rain')]
    pcts = sorted(x['pct'] for x in sun) or [0]; md = sorted(x['mdrop'] for x in sun) or [0]
    bmin = min([x['ch'] for x in bad] or [0]); db = sum(x['dirBad'] for x in R); sk = sum(x['sky'] for x in R)
    print(f"{sc:12s} | {pcts[0]:.2f} / {pcts[len(pcts)//2]:.2f}        | {md[len(md)//2]:5.1f} (min {md[0]:.1f})          | {bmin:6d}               | {db} | {sk}")
    if pcts[0] < (.25 if sc == 'mercu' else .5): why.append(sc+':cerah ch<0.5%')
    if db: why.append(sc+':arah salah')
    if sk: why.append(sc+':bayangan di langit')
    if bmin == 0: why.append(sc+':mendung tanpa oklusi')
    if sc == 'cermin' and any(x['menaraAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('cermin:menara tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['pohonAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:pohon tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['objSh'] > 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:bayangan jatuh di benda lain')
    if sc in ('airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','gerbang','cermin','siluet') and any(x['aoSum'] == 0 for x in R): why.append(sc+':oklusi ambien nol')
json.dump(r, open('/tmp/audit_'+os.path.basename(f)+'.json','w'))
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not why else 'GAGAL ('+'; '.join(why)+')')
```
```refl151.py
# refl151.py (Tahap 151a): uji PANTULAN adegan siluet di Chromium nyata. Pakai: python3 refl151.py <berkas.html> [ambang]
# Metrik: KONTRAS PANTULAN POHON = selisih mutlak rata-rata luminans air tepat di bawah pulau (kolom pohon +-4, baris by+25..by+70)
# terhadap air di sisi dalam bingkai (pohon x +- (95..125), arah ke tengah) pada baris yang sama. Tanpa pantulan benda: kontras ~ 0.
import sys, os, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, out = [];
 const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
 for (const [mn, wx, sd] of [[780,'clear',1],[780,'clear',2],[780,'clear',4],[960,'clear',3],[600,'few',5],[1320,'clear',1],[780,'cloud',2]]) {
  const e = PX.create({ scene: 'siluet', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0, .7]) e.frame(t, o);
  const T = e.cs.filter(c => c.nm === 'pohon')[0]; if (!T) { out.push({ mn, wx, sd, none: 1 }); continue; }
  const side = T.x < W / 2 ? 1 : -1; let a = 0, an = 0, b = 0, bn = 0; const y0 = T.by + 25, y1 = Math.min(H - 2, T.by + 70);
  for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) { for (let x = Math.round(T.x) - 4; x <= Math.round(T.x) + 4; x++) if (x >= 0 && x < W) { a += lum(o[y*W+x]); an++; }
    for (let d = 95; d <= 125; d++) { const x = Math.round(T.x) + side * d; if (x >= 0 && x < W) { b += lum(o[y*W+x]); bn++; } } }
  out.push({ mn, wx, sd, x: Math.round(T.x), by: T.by, kontras: bn && an ? +Math.abs(a/an - b/bn).toFixed(1) : -1, rows: y1 - y0 + 1 }); }
 return out; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200); r = pg.evaluate(JS); b.close()
for x in r: print(x)
TH = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 8.0
ok = all(x.get('kontras', 0) >= TH for x in r if x['wx'] in ('clear', 'few') and not x.get('none'))
print('galat halaman', len(perr)); print('VONIS-PANTULAN:', 'LULUS' if ok and not perr else 'GAGAL', '(ambang kontras >= %s pada cerah/sedikit awan)' % TH)
```
```seam151.py
# seam151.py (Tahap 151a): uji GARIS SAMBUNGAN AWAN adegan siluet (v150a: tanda arah awan melompat tepat di x matahari). Pakai: python3 seam151.py <berkas.html> [ambang]
# Metrik: rata-rata |selisih luminans kolom bersebelahan| pada baris langit atas (di atas tajuk) di kolom x matahari +-2, dibagi median nilai yang sama di semua kolom. Garis sambungan -> rasio besar.
import sys, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, out = [];
 const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
 for (const [mn, wx, sd] of [[780,'cloud',1],[360,'snow',1],[960,'storm',2],[780,'rain',1],[1080,'fog',2],[600,'cloud',3],[500,'rain',4]]) {
  const e = PX.create({ scene: 'siluet', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0, .5, 1, 1.5, 2]) e.frame(t, o);
  const T = e.cs.filter(c => c.nm === 'pohon')[0], top = T ? T.by - T.hmax : e.zone.hy * .5, y1 = Math.max(8, Math.min(Math.round(top) - 4, Math.round(e.zone.hy * .6)));
  const col = []; for (let x = 0; x < W - 1; x++) { let s = 0; for (let y = 0; y < y1; y++) s += Math.abs(lum(o[y*W+x+1]) - lum(o[y*W+x])); col.push(s / y1); }
  const sx = Math.round(e.cs.sx); let seam = 0; for (let x = sx - 2; x <= sx + 2; x++) if (x >= 0 && x < W - 1) seam = Math.max(seam, col[x]);
  const sorted = col.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b), med = sorted[sorted.length >> 1] || 1e-6;
  out.push({ mn, wx, sd, sx, rows: y1, seam: +seam.toFixed(2), med: +med.toFixed(2), rasio: +(seam / med).toFixed(2) }); }
 return out; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200); r = pg.evaluate(JS); b.close()
for x in r: print(x)
TH = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2.5
ok = all(x['rasio'] < TH for x in r)
print('galat halaman', len(perr)); print('VONIS-SAMBUNGAN:', 'LULUS' if ok and not perr else 'GAGAL', '(rasio < %s)' % TH)
```
```mut151a.py
# mut151a.py (Tahap 151a): mutan cepat adegan siluet. audit-adegan.py dan refl149.py harus ada di folder yang sama. Pakai: python3 mut151a.py <berkas.html>
import subprocess, sys, os
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))
a = base.index('/* ===== v150a: adegan ke-19'); b = base.index('/* ===== /v150a adegan siluet ===== */'); blk = base[a:b]
def run(p, kind):
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'audit-adegan.py' if kind == 'audit' else 'refl151.py' if kind == 'refl' else 'seam151.py', p] + (['ringkas'] if kind == 'audit' else []), capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=D)
    v = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('VONIS')]; return v[0] if v else (r.stdout[-300:] + r.stderr[-300:])
def job(name, kind, pairs):
    s = blk
    for old, new, cnt in pairs:
        assert s.count(old) == cnt, (name, old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
    p = os.path.join(D, 'mut_%s.html' % name); open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(base[:a] + s + base[b:]); v = run(p, kind); os.remove(p)
    return name, ('TERTANGKAP' if 'GAGAL' in v and (kind in ('refl', 'sky') or 'siluet' in v) else 'LOLOS (BURUK)') + ' | ' + v[:170]
J = [
 ('S1_bayangan_mati', 'audit', [("CS = [], CSH = o.csh !== 0", "CS = [], CSH = false", 1)]),
 ('S2_arah_dibalik', 'audit', [("d_.dxr *= .55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", "d_.dxr *= -.55; d_.dyr *= .55; const pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by,", 1)]),
 ('S3_bayangan_di_langit', 'audit', [("ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H && gm[y * W + x] === 1;", "ok_ = (x, y) => x >= 0 && x < W && y >= 0 && y < H;", 1)]),
 ('S4_oklusi_dibuang', 'audit', [("ao = shAO(W, H, isT ? xT : cxo, ob.by + 1, rxA, clamp(rxA * .22, 2, 5), .5, ok_, dk_, shm);", "ao = 0;", 1)]),
 ('R1_pantulan_tanpa_cermin', 'refl', [("sy = Math.round(2 * m - y + dyw)", "sy = Math.round(y + dyw)", 1)]),
 ('R2_pantulan_nol', 'refl', [("rf0 = (.92 - .5 * Math.pow(q, .75)) * (1 - .3 * Math.min(1, rg / 3))", "rf0 = 0", 1)]),
 ('C1_awan_garis_sambungan', 'sky', [("const sgx = -clamp((x - sxw) / (W * .12), -1, 1);", "const sgx = sxw < x ? -1 : 1;", 1)]),
]
print('asli audit  ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'audit')); print('asli pantulan ->', run(sys.argv[1], 'refl'))
SEL = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
J = [j for k, j in enumerate(J) if SEL is None or k in SEL]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as ex:
    for name, res in ex.map(lambda j: job(*j), J): print(name.ljust(26), '->', res)
```

```test148a.py
# (151a: A1 diubah dari 18 ke 19 adegan)
# test148a.py: uji suara adegan 148a. Pakai: python3 test148a.py <berkas.html> [cepat]
import sys, os, json, itertools
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]); quick = len(sys.argv) > 2
fails = []
def chk(name, ok, info=''):
    print(('OK   ' if ok else 'GAGAL'), name, info)
    if not ok: fails.append(name)
STAT = r'''() => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = { bad: [], keys: {}, empty: [], evbad: [], birdsNight: [], birdsRain: [], sceneJson: {}, wxSame: [], phSame: [], duskSame: [], dawnSame: [] };
 const WX = ['clear','cloud','fog','rain','storm','snow'], MIN = [360, 780, 1080, 1320], sc = S.scenes();
 for (const s of sc) for (const m of MIN) for (const w of WX) { const r = S.recipe(s, m, w); if (!r) { out.empty.push([s, m, w]); continue; }
  const num = [r.vol, r.lp]; r.beds.forEach(L => num.push(L.g, L.hz, L.f === undefined ? 1 : L.f)); r.ev.forEach(E => { num.push(E.r, E.g); if (!S.EV.includes(E.k)) out.evbad.push([s, E.k]); });
  if (num.some(x => !isFinite(x) || x < 0) || r.vol <= 0 || r.vol > 1.2 || !r.beds.length) out.bad.push([s, m, w]);
  if (r.ph === 'night' && r.ev.some(E => E.k === 'bird')) out.birdsNight.push([s, m, w]);
  if ((w === 'rain' || w === 'storm' || w === 'snow') && r.ev.some(E => E.k === 'bird' || E.k === 'cricket')) out.birdsRain.push([s, m, w]);
  if (m === 780 && w === 'clear') out.sceneJson[s] = JSON.stringify([r.beds, r.ev]); }
 for (const s of sc) { if (s === 'akuarium') continue; const a = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').ev]), b = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').ev]); if (a === b) out.wxSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['airterjun','padang','dusun','danau','embun','atap']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').ev), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 1320, 'clear').ev); if (a === b) out.phSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 1080, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.duskSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 360, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.dawnSame.push(s); }
 out.n = sc.length; out.uniq = new Set(Object.values(out.sceneJson)).size; return out; }'''
OFF = r'''async (cases) => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = {};
 const fft = (re, im) => { const n = re.length; for (let i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) { let b = n >> 1; for (; j & b; b >>= 1) j ^= b; j ^= b; if (i < j) { [re[i], re[j]] = [re[j], re[i]]; [im[i], im[j]] = [im[j], im[i]]; } }
  for (let len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) { const a = -2 * Math.PI / len, wr = Math.cos(a), wi = Math.sin(a); for (let i = 0; i < n; i += len) { let cr = 1, ci = 0; for (let j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) { const ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j], vr = re[i + j + len / 2] * cr - im[i + j + len / 2] * ci, vi = re[i + j + len / 2] * ci + im[i + j + len / 2] * cr; re[i + j] = ur + vr; im[i + j] = ui + vi; re[i + j + len / 2] = ur - vr; im[i + j + len / 2] = ui - vi; const t = cr * wr - ci * wi; ci = cr * wi + ci * wr; cr = t; } } } };
 const EDG = [60, 120, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3500, 5500, 9000, 16000];
 for (const [sc, m, wx] of cases) { const d = await S.render(sc, m, wx, 5, 7); let s2 = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const v = d[i]; if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } s2 += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); }
  const N = 4096, bands = new Float64Array(EDG.length - 1); for (let o = 0; o + N <= d.length; o += N * 2) { const re = new Float64Array(N), im = new Float64Array(N); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) re[i] = d[o + i] * (.5 - .5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / N)); fft(re, im); for (let k = 1; k < N / 2; k++) { const fr = k * 44100 / N; for (let b = 0; b < EDG.length - 1; b++) if (fr >= EDG[b] && fr < EDG[b + 1]) { bands[b] += re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k]; break; } } }
  const tot = bands.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1; out[sc + '|' + m + '|' + wx] = { rms: 20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(s2 / d.length) + 1e-9), pk, nan, bands: Array.from(bands, b => b / tot) }; }
 return out; }'''
INIT = "window.__osc=0;window.__bs=0;const A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(A){const o=A.prototype.createOscillator,b=A.prototype.createBufferSource;A.prototype.createOscillator=function(){window.__osc++;return o.call(this)};A.prototype.createBufferSource=function(){window.__bs++;return b.call(this)};}"
with sync_playwright() as p:
    br = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'])
    ctx = br.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}); ctx.add_init_script(INIT); pg = ctx.new_page(); perr = []
    pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + f, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
    # --- A statik
    st = pg.evaluate(STAT)
    chk('A1 19 adegan punya resep', st['n'] == 19 and not st['empty'], st['n'])
    chk('A2 angka sah semua resep', not st['bad'], st['bad'][:3])
    chk('A3 semua jenis kejadian ada', not st['evbad'], st['evbad'][:3])
    chk('A4 resep tiap adegan unik', st['uniq'] == st['n'], st['uniq'])
    chk('A5 cuaca mengubah resep', not st['wxSame'], st['wxSame'])
    chk('A6 jam mengubah resep adegan bernyawa', not st['phSame'], st['phSame'])
    chk('A9 senja dan fajar beda dari siang', not st['duskSame'] and not st['dawnSame'], [st['duskSame'], st['dawnSame']])
    chk('A7 tanpa burung saat malam', not st['birdsNight'], st['birdsNight'][:3])
    chk('A8 tanpa burung/jangkrik saat hujan/badai/salju', not st['birdsRain'], st['birdsRain'][:3])
    # --- B luring
    sc = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.scenes()')
    cases = [[s, 780, 'clear'] for s in sc] + ([] if quick else [[s, m, w] for s in sc for m, w in [(1320, 'rain'), (1320, 'storm'), (360, 'fog'), (600, 'snow')]])
    r = pg.evaluate(OFF, cases)
    nan = [k for k, v in r.items() if v['nan']]; pk = [(k, round(v['pk'], 2)) for k, v in r.items() if v['pk'] > .9]
    lo = [(k, round(v['rms'], 1)) for k, v in r.items() if v['rms'] < -50 or v['rms'] > -22]
    chk('B1 tanpa NaN', not nan, nan[:3]); chk('B2 puncak < 0,9 (tidak pecah)', not pk, pk[:3]); chk('B3 kekerasan -50..-22 dBFS', not lo, lo[:4])
    cl = {k.split('|')[0]: v['bands'] for k, v in r.items() if k.endswith('|780|clear')}; names = list(cl); md = 9
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(names, 2):
        d = sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(cl[a], cl[b])); md = min(md, d)
        if d < .08: print('   dekat:', a, b, round(d, 3))
    chk('B4 spektrum antar adegan berbeda (jarak L1 min >= 0,08)', md >= .08, round(md, 3))
    if not quick:
        wd = [s for s in sc if s != 'akuarium' and sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(r[s + '|780|clear']['bands'], r[s + '|1320|rain']['bands'])) < .03 and abs(r[s + '|780|clear']['rms'] - r[s + '|1320|rain']['rms']) < .8]
        chk('B5 hujan terdengar beda dari cerah', not wd, wd)
        sq = [s for s in sc if r[s + '|600|snow']['rms'] > r[s + '|780|clear']['rms'] + 3]
        chk('B6 salju tidak lebih keras dari cerah', not sq, sq)
    # --- C langsung
    s0 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C1 bawaan MATI, tanpa AudioContext', s0['on'] is False and s0['ctx'] == 'none' and s0['made'] == 0, s0)
    chk('C2 tombol speaker ada, aria-pressed=false', pg.evaluate("(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#hxSky>.sndbtn');return !!b&&b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='false'})()"))
    sk0 = pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.contains('skyfocus')")
    pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    s1 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'); pk_ = pg.evaluate('window.DL.pxbg.key()')
    chk('C3 klik menyalakan: ctx running, gain naik', s1['on'] and s1['ctx'] == 'running' and s1['gain'] > .25, s1)
    chk('C4 pilihan tersimpan "1"', pg.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('dailylog:snd:on')") == '1')
    exp = pg.evaluate("(()=>{const a=window.DL.pxbg.key().split('|');const r=window.DL.snd.recipe(a[0],+a[1],a[2]);return r&&r.key})()")
    chk('C5 resep aktif = adegan header sekarang', s1['key'] == exp and bool(exp), (s1['key'], exp))
    pg.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('dailylog:pxbg:scene','akuarium');window.DL.pxbg.step()"); pg.wait_for_timeout(3200)
    e1 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state().ev'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3000); e2 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state().ev')
    chk('C6 kejadian acak terjadwal terus (adegan akuarium, gelembung)', e2 - e1 >= 3, (e1, e2))
    pg.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('dailylog:pxbg:scene');window.DL.pxbg.step()"); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    pg.evaluate("Object.defineProperty(document,'hidden',{configurable:true,get:()=>true});document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'))"); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    chk('C7 tab tersembunyi: diam', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] < .03, pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'))
    pg.evaluate("delete document.hidden;document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'))"); pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
    chk('C8 tab terlihat lagi: bersuara', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] > .25, pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'))
    pg.click('button[data-view="train"]'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
    chk('C9 Beranda tidak terbuka: diam', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] < .03, pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'))
    pg.click('button[data-view="home"]'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
    chk('C10 kembali ke Beranda: bersuara', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] > .25)
    pg.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('dailylog:pxbg:off','1')"); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    chk('C11 latar pixel mati: diam', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] < .03, pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'))
    pg.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('dailylog:pxbg:off')"); pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
    pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.add('skyfocus')"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
    cs = pg.evaluate("(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#hxSky>.sndbtn');if(!b)return null;const c=getComputedStyle(b);return [c.opacity,c.pointerEvents]})()")
    chk('C12 mode animasi: tombol tetap terbaca dan bisa diketuk', cs is not None and float(cs[0]) > .5 and cs[1] == 'auto', cs)
    pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.remove('skyfocus')")
    for _ in range(3): pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
    chk('C13 ketuk tombol 3x tidak memicu mode animasi', pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.contains('skyfocus')") == sk0)
    on_now = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.on()')   # 3 klik dari "menyala" -> mati
    if on_now: pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(3500); s2 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C14 dimatikan: gain 0, ctx suspended, tersimpan "0"', (not s2['on']) and s2['gain'] < .03 and s2['ctx'] == 'suspended' and pg.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('dailylog:snd:on')") == '0', s2)
    pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(800)   # nyalakan lagi lalu muat ulang
    pg.reload(wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(2200)
    s3 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C15 muat ulang: pilihan MENYALA tersimpan tetapi belum ada AudioContext sebelum ketukan', s3['on'] and s3['made'] == 0 and s3['ctx'] == 'none', s3)
    pg.mouse.click(200, 700); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500); s4 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C16 ketukan pertama memulai suara', s4['ctx'] == 'running' and s4['gain'] > .25, s4)
    chk('C17 tanpa galat halaman', not perr, perr[:3])
    br.close()
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not fails else 'GAGAL ' + ', '.join(fails))
```

#### 152a (6 Nov 2026): ADEGAN KE-20 `ramp` DIPASANG; `daily-log.html` = v152a (audit, sapuan, bukti efek, tangkapan 390x274 LULUS; suara diuji, mutan cepat, kalibrasi CAL BELUM)
- **Tema (hasil pengacak, sudah dicatat di entri 151a, TIDAK diacak ulang):** genre = film perang (parit, medan perang); POV = orang pertama sebagai tokoh di tempat ikonik; palet = pastel permen; suasana = kacau. Unik terhadap `SCN` (19 adegan lama) dan RIWAYAT-TEMA. **Baris RIWAYAT-TEMA sudah ditambahkan di serah ini** (`ramp | film perang (parit, medan perang) | orang pertama sebagai tokoh di tempat ikonik | pastel permen | kacau`).
- **Tafsiran saya:** pendaratan di pantai berbenteng dilihat dari ujung landasan kapal pendarat (tempat ikonik), pixel art mainan permen pastel; TANPA darah, TANPA tokoh terluka; kekacauan lewat ledakan kapas permen di udara, tiang air ledakan, tembakan pelacak berwarna, pesawat berpita, lampu sorot dan suar malam.
- **Isi adegan (digambar ulang dari kode sendiri, mesin `RAMP`, blok `/* ===== v152a` sampai `/* ===== /v152a adegan ramp ===== */`):** BACKGROUND = langit pastel menurut jam, matahari/bulan, awan kapas, bintang, berkas sinar, lampu sorot menyapu (malam/senja), dua pesawat berpita pastel, ledakan udara berwarna, dua lapis tebing (merah muda-lavender, tutup rumput mint) dengan dua bunker yang berkedip dan menembakkan pelacak; MIDDLEGROUND = pantai pasir krem-persik dengan pasir basah, kawah elips, 13 landak baja (tiga balok bersilang bergaris permen, ukuran = (y-cakrawala) x faktor acak, sudut acak, sisi terang/gelap menurut matahari), 5 sampai 8 tentara mainan berlari ke tebing (warna seragam dan helm acak, ayunan kaki dan tangan, ransel), garis buih bergelombang, tiga tiang air/pasir ledakan bergantian (naik, mengembang, jatuh, buih elips, percikan konfeti balistik, kilat dan bloom); FOREGROUND = dinding landasan dan lantai berchevron menuju satu titik hilang (rivet dan sambungan plat berjarak menurut kedalaman, pita merah muda-putih), tepi helm berjaring di atas (POV orang pertama), tetes buram (DOF) melintas di depan kamera.
- **Pemasangan (`patch152a.py`, di bawah; v151a -> v152a):** blok mesin disisipkan sebelum `const SCN`; `'ramp'` ditambah ke `SCN` (pemilih per jam otomatis ikut) dan rantai `create0`; resep suara `ramp(c)` di tabel `SND` (ombak coklat, desir, angin, guntur jauh, letupan, sirene) BELUM diuji; `CAL.ramp = 1` BELUM dikalibrasi.
- **Alat uji diperbarui:** `audit-adegan.py` kini memuat `ramp` (15 adegan) dan syarat oklusi ambien untuk `ramp`; `sweep152.py` dan `fxproof152.py` di bawah.
