**Pakai:** ekstrak dengan pola ekstraksi 147a (blok TERAKHIR bernama sama menang), lalu `python3 audit-adegan.py <html>`, `python3 sweep152.py <html>`, `python3 fxproof152.py <html>`, `python3 shot1.py <html> <png> "ramp:780:clear:1;ramp:1320:clear:1"`. `patch152a.py` butuh `ramp152.js` + `hdr.js` (diambil dari html v152a: blok `function RAMP(o)` sampai `/* ===== /v152a`; `hdr.js` = baris 2 sampai 10 blok `SILUET`); untuk memasang ulang cukup memakai html v152a.
```patch152a.py
# patch152a.py: pasang adegan ke-20 `ramp` + resep suara. Pakai: python3 patch152a.py in.html ramp152.js hdr.js out.html [kal]
import sys
s = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); g = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read(); h = open(sys.argv[3], encoding='utf-8').read(); K = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else '1'
g = g.replace('HDR', h, 1)
def rep(old, new, cnt=1):
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == cnt, (old[:60], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
rep("  const SCN = ['airterjun',", g + "\n  const SCN = ['airterjun',")
rep("'gerbang', 'cermin', 'siluet'];", "'gerbang', 'cermin', 'siluet', 'ramp'];")
rep("o.scene === 'siluet' ? SILUET(o) :", "o.scene === 'siluet' ? SILUET(o) : o.scene === 'ramp' ? RAMP(o) :")
SND = "    ramp(c) { c.b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 360, g: .22, lfo: [.1, .7] }).b({ n: 'pink', ft: 'bandpass', hz: 900, q: .6, g: .07, lfo: [.13, .8] }).b({ n: 'brown', ft: 'lowpass', hz: 90, g: .12, lfo: [.05, .4] }); c.wind(.1, 620); c.e({ k: 'thunder', r: .25, g: .09 }); c.e({ k: 'crackle', r: 2.4, g: .04 }); c.e({ k: 'horn', r: .008, g: .05 }); },\n"
rep("  };\n  const CAL = {", SND + "  };\n  const CAL = {")
rep("cermin: 1.7, siluet: 1 };", "cermin: 1.7, siluet: 1, ramp: " + K + " };")
open(sys.argv[4], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))
```
```audit-adegan.py
# audit-adegan.py (Tahap 147a; 151a2: siluet juga diperiksa 'bayangan tidak jatuh di benda lain' lewat e.lmask; 151a: memuat adegan `siluet` (langit bukan batu = bukan gm, pohon wajib punya oklusi pangkal); diperketat 149b: cermin memakai topeng batu `e.rock` untuk 'bukan langit' dan menara wajib punya oklusi pangkal): audit pra-adegan bayangan benda statis, SEMUA adegan, Chromium nyata.
# Pakai: python3 audit-adegan.py <berkas.html> [ringkas]   -> mencetak tabel + VONIS
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SMALL = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = r'''
async (cfg) => {
  const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, rows = [], errs = [];
  const NAT = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan'];
  const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
  for (const sc of cfg.scenes) for (const [hn, mn] of cfg.hours) for (const wx of cfg.wxs) for (const sd of cfg.seeds) {
    try {
      const mk = csh => { const e = PX.create({ scene: sc, W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0,.5,1]) e.frame(t,o); return [e,o]; };
      const [e1,o1] = mk(undefined), [e0,o0] = mk(0);
      let ch = 0, drop = 0, sky = 0, objSh = 0; const LY = e1.lay; for (let i = 0; i < o1.length; i++) if (o1[i] !== o0[i]) { ch++; if (sc === 'siluet' && e1.lmask && e1.lmask[i] === 2 && e1.rock[i] !== 1) objSh++; drop += lum(o0[i]) - lum(o1[i]); if (LY && NAT.includes(sc) && LY[i] === 0) sky++; else if (['mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet'].includes(sc) && e1.zone && ((i / W) | 0) <= e1.zone.hy && !((sc === 'cermin' || sc === 'siluet') && e1.rock && e1.rock[i] === 1)) sky++; }
      const cs = e1.cs || []; let sx = cs.sx; const sunU = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mn - 330)/800));
      if (sx == null) sx = (.14 + .72*sunU)*W;
      let dirBad = 0, nObj = 0, spSum = 0;
      for (const c of cs) { nObj++; spSum += c.sp||0; const side = sx - c.x; if ((c.sp||0) > 40 && Math.abs(side) > 8 && ((side > 0 && c.dxr > 0) || (side < 0 && c.dxr < 0))) dirBad++; }
      const mnr = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'menara'), phn = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'pohon'); rows.push({ sc, hn, wx, sd, menaraAo: mnr ? mnr.ao : -1, pohonAo: phn ? phn.ao : -1, objSh, ch, pct: +(100*ch/(W*H)).toFixed(3), mdrop: ch ? +(drop/ch).toFixed(1) : 0, nObj, spSum, dirBad, sky, aoSum: cs.reduce((t, c) => t + (c.ao || 0), 0) });
    } catch (err) { errs.push(sc+' '+hn+' '+wx+' '+sd+': '+err.message); }
  }
  return { rows, errs };
}'''
scenes = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','atap','mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet','ramp']
cfg = dict(scenes=scenes, hours=[[7,420],[10,600],[13,780],[16,960]] if not SMALL else [[7,420],[13,780]],
           wxs=['clear','few','cloud','rain'] if not SMALL else ['clear','rain'], seeds=[1,2] if not SMALL else [1])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':780})
    perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://'+os.path.abspath(f), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, cfg); b.close()
rows = r['rows']; print('kombinasi', len(rows), 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
why = []
print('adegan       | cerah ch% min/med | selisih terang rata2 (cerah) | mendung-hujan ch min | arahSalah | piksel di langit')
for sc in scenes:
    R = [x for x in rows if x['sc'] == sc]; sun = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('clear','few')]
    bad = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('cloud','rain')]
    pcts = sorted(x['pct'] for x in sun) or [0]; md = sorted(x['mdrop'] for x in sun) or [0]
    bmin = min([x['ch'] for x in bad] or [0]); db = sum(x['dirBad'] for x in R); sk = sum(x['sky'] for x in R)
    print(f"{sc:12s} | {pcts[0]:.2f} / {pcts[len(pcts)//2]:.2f}        | {md[len(md)//2]:5.1f} (min {md[0]:.1f})          | {bmin:6d}               | {db} | {sk}")
    if pcts[0] < (.25 if sc == 'mercu' else .5): why.append(sc+':cerah ch<0.5%')
    if db: why.append(sc+':arah salah')
    if sk: why.append(sc+':bayangan di langit')
    if bmin == 0: why.append(sc+':mendung tanpa oklusi')
    if sc == 'cermin' and any(x['menaraAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('cermin:menara tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['pohonAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:pohon tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['objSh'] > 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:bayangan jatuh di benda lain')
    if sc in ('airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','gerbang','cermin','siluet','ramp') and any(x['aoSum'] == 0 for x in R): why.append(sc+':oklusi ambien nol')
json.dump(r, open('/tmp/audit_'+os.path.basename(f)+'.json','w'))
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not why else 'GAGAL ('+'; '.join(why)+')')
```

# sweep147b.py: sapuan adegan cermin x 7 jam x 7 cuaca x 3 seed (390x274 dan 195x137), cek galat, NaN, kecerahan. Pakai: python3 sweep147b.py <berkas.html>
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, res = { n: 0, errs: [], dark: [], bright: [] };
 for (const [W, H] of [[390, 274], [195, 137]]) for (const mn of [330, 420, 600, 780, 960, 1090, 1320]) for (const wx of ['clear','few','cloud','fog','rain','storm','snow']) for (const sd of [1, 2, 3]) {
  try { const e = PX.create({ scene: 'ramp', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); let s = 0; for (const t of [0, .7, 1.9, 4.2]) e.frame(t, o);
   for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) { const c = o[i]; s += (c & 255) + ((c >> 8) & 255) + ((c >> 16) & 255); if ((c >>> 24) !== 255) { res.errs.push('alfa ' + W + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx); break; } }
   const m = s / (o.length * 3); res.n++; if (m < 6) res.dark.push([W, mn, wx, sd, +m.toFixed(1)]); if (m > 170) res.bright.push([W, mn, wx, sd, +m.toFixed(1)]);
  } catch (er) { res.errs.push(W + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx + ' ' + sd + ': ' + er.message); } }
 return res; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200); r = pg.evaluate(JS); b.close()
print('kombinasi', r['n'], 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr), 'terlalu gelap', len(r['dark']), 'terlalu terang', len(r['bright']))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
print('gelap contoh', r['dark'][:4]); print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not r['errs'] and not perr and not r['dark'] and not r['bright'] else 'GAGAL')
```

# fxproof148b.py: bukti efek dengan/tanpa (nofx) adegan cermin, persen piksel berubah + rasio kecerahan. Pakai: python3 fxproof148b.py <berkas.html>
import sys, os, json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
JS = r'''async () => { const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, out = {};
 const mk = (nf, mn, wx, csh) => { const e = PX.create({ scene: 'ramp', W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: 2, nofx: nf, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0, .7, 1.9]) e.frame(t, o); return o; };
 const lum = o => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) { const c = o[i]; s += (c & 255) + ((c >> 8) & 255) + ((c >> 16) & 255); } return s / (o.length * 3); };
 for (const [fx, mn, wx] of [['shafts', 960, 'clear'], ['shafts', 1320, 'clear'], ['bloom', 780, 'clear'], ['bloom', 1320, 'clear'], ['dof', 780, 'clear'], ['rim', 780, 'clear'], ['ambient', 780, 'clear'], ['ambient', 1320, 'clear'], ['glit', 780, 'clear'], ['aoc', 780, 'clear'], ['refl', 780, 'clear'], ['cshadow', 780, 'clear'], ['flare', 1320, 'clear'], ['flare', 1100, 'clear']]) { const a = mk([], mn, wx), b = mk([fx], mn, wx); let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) d++; out[fx + ' ' + mn + ' ' + wx] = [+(100 * d / a.length).toFixed(2), +(lum(a) / lum(b)).toFixed(3)]; }
 for (const [mn, wx] of [[780, 'clear'], [960, 'clear']]) { const a = mk([], mn, wx, undefined), b = mk([], mn, wx, 0); let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) d++; out['bayangan-jatuh ' + mn + ' ' + wx] = [+(100 * d / a.length).toFixed(2), +(lum(a) / lum(b)).toFixed(3)]; }
 return out; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); pg.goto('file://' + os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS)
    for k, v in r.items(): print(k.ljust(28), 'piksel berubah %', v[0], ' rasio terang', v[1])
    b.close()

Diperbaiki: resep `ramp` diganti jadi gemuruh dalam coklat 75 Hz (g .34) + desis pita 2600 Hz (g .09, kresek tembakan) + coklat 240 Hz, angin kecil, guntur jauh, letupan, sirene jauh. # audit-adegan.py (Tahap 147a; 151a2: siluet juga diperiksa 'bayangan tidak jatuh di benda lain' lewat e.lmask; 151a: memuat adegan `siluet` (langit bukan batu = bukan gm, pohon wajib punya oklusi pangkal); diperketat 149b: cermin memakai topeng batu `e.rock` untuk 'bukan langit' dan menara wajib punya oklusi pangkal): audit pra-adegan bayangan benda statis, SEMUA adegan, Chromium nyata.
# Pakai: python3 audit-adegan.py <berkas.html> [ringkas]   -> mencetak tabel + VONIS
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SMALL = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = r'''
async (cfg) => {
  const PX = window.DL.pxbg, W = 390, H = 274, rows = [], errs = [];
  const NAT = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan'];
  const lum = c => .3*(c&255) + .59*((c>>8)&255) + .11*((c>>16)&255);
  for (const sc of cfg.scenes) for (const [hn, mn] of cfg.hours) for (const wx of cfg.wxs) for (const sd of cfg.seeds) {
    try {
      const mk = csh => { const e = PX.create({ scene: sc, W, H, min: mn, wx, seed: sd, csh }); const o = new Uint32Array(W*H); for (const t of [0,.5,1]) e.frame(t,o); return [e,o]; };
      const [e1,o1] = mk(undefined), [e0,o0] = mk(0);
      let ch = 0, drop = 0, sky = 0, objSh = 0; const LY = e1.lay; for (let i = 0; i < o1.length; i++) if (o1[i] !== o0[i]) { ch++; if (sc === 'siluet' && e1.lmask && e1.lmask[i] === 2 && e1.rock[i] !== 1) objSh++; drop += lum(o0[i]) - lum(o1[i]); if (LY && NAT.includes(sc) && LY[i] === 0) sky++; else if (['mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet'].includes(sc) && e1.zone && ((i / W) | 0) <= e1.zone.hy && !((sc === 'cermin' || sc === 'siluet') && e1.rock && e1.rock[i] === 1)) sky++; }
      const cs = e1.cs || []; let sx = cs.sx; const sunU = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mn - 330)/800));
      if (sx == null) sx = (.14 + .72*sunU)*W;
      let dirBad = 0, nObj = 0, spSum = 0;
      for (const c of cs) { nObj++; spSum += c.sp||0; const side = sx - c.x; if ((c.sp||0) > 40 && Math.abs(side) > 8 && ((side > 0 && c.dxr > 0) || (side < 0 && c.dxr < 0))) dirBad++; }
      const mnr = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'menara'), phn = cs.find(c => c.nm === 'pohon'), lsp = cs.filter(c => c.nm === 'landak').reduce((q, c) => q + (c.sp || 0), 0); rows.push({ sc, hn, wx, sd, lsp, menaraAo: mnr ? mnr.ao : -1, pohonAo: phn ? phn.ao : -1, objSh, ch, pct: +(100*ch/(W*H)).toFixed(3), mdrop: ch ? +(drop/ch).toFixed(1) : 0, nObj, spSum, dirBad, sky, aoSum: cs.reduce((t, c) => t + (c.ao || 0), 0) });
    } catch (err) { errs.push(sc+' '+hn+' '+wx+' '+sd+': '+err.message); }
  }
  return { rows, errs };
}'''
scenes = ['airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','atap','mercu','kapal','gerbang','cermin','siluet','ramp']
cfg = dict(scenes=scenes, hours=[[7,420],[10,600],[13,780],[16,960]] if not SMALL else [[7,420],[13,780]],
           wxs=['clear','few','cloud','rain'] if not SMALL else ['clear','rain'], seeds=[1,2] if not SMALL else [1])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':780})
    perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://'+os.path.abspath(f), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, cfg); b.close()
rows = r['rows']; print('kombinasi', len(rows), 'galat', len(r['errs']), 'galat halaman', len(perr))
for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)
why = []
print('adegan       | cerah ch% min/med | selisih terang rata2 (cerah) | mendung-hujan ch min | arahSalah | piksel di langit')
for sc in scenes:
    R = [x for x in rows if x['sc'] == sc]; sun = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('clear','few')]
    bad = [x for x in R if x['wx'] in ('cloud','rain')]
    pcts = sorted(x['pct'] for x in sun) or [0]; md = sorted(x['mdrop'] for x in sun) or [0]
    bmin = min([x['ch'] for x in bad] or [0]); db = sum(x['dirBad'] for x in R); sk = sum(x['sky'] for x in R)
    print(f"{sc:12s} | {pcts[0]:.2f} / {pcts[len(pcts)//2]:.2f}        | {md[len(md)//2]:5.1f} (min {md[0]:.1f})          | {bmin:6d}               | {db} | {sk}")
    if pcts[0] < (.25 if sc == 'mercu' else .5): why.append(sc+':cerah ch<0.5%')
    if db: why.append(sc+':arah salah')
    if sk: why.append(sc+':bayangan di langit')
    if bmin == 0: why.append(sc+':mendung tanpa oklusi')
    if sc == 'cermin' and any(x['menaraAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('cermin:menara tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'ramp' and any(x['lsp'] == 0 for x in sun): why.append('ramp:landak tanpa bayangan jatuh')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['pohonAo'] == 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:pohon tanpa oklusi pangkal')
    if sc == 'siluet' and any(x['objSh'] > 0 for x in R): why.append('siluet:bayangan jatuh di benda lain')
    if sc in ('airterjun','padang','dusun','kastil','danau','reruntuhan','pantai','pegunungan','gerbang','cermin','siluet','ramp') and any(x['aoSum'] == 0 for x in R): why.append(sc+':oklusi ambien nol')
json.dump(r, open('/tmp/audit_'+os.path.basename(f)+'.json','w'))
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not why else 'GAGAL ('+'; '.join(why)+')')

# mut152a.py: mutan cepat adegan ramp (audit-adegan.py harus ada di folder yang sama). Pakai: python3 mut152a.py <berkas.html>
import subprocess, sys, os
base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))
def run(p):
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'audit-adegan.py', p, 'ringkas'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=D)
    v = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('VONIS')]; return v[0] if v else (r.stdout[-300:] + r.stderr[-300:])
def mut(name, pairs):
    s = base
    for old, new, cnt in pairs:
        assert s.count(old) == cnt, (name, old[:50], s.count(old)); s = s.replace(old, new)
    p = os.path.join(D, 'mut_%s.html' % name); open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); v = run(p); os.remove(p); print(name, '->', 'TERTANGKAP' if 'GAGAL' in v and 'ramp' in v else v[:200])
print('asli ->', run(sys.argv[1]))
mut('R1_mati', [("if (CSH && ob.by <= ysh) {", "if (false && ob.by <= ysh) {", 1)])
mut('R2_arah', [("d_.dxr *= .55; d_.dyr *= .55; pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by", "d_.dxr *= -.55; d_.dyr *= .55; pl = shCast(W, H, sil, ob.by", 1)])
mut('R3_oklusi', [("CS.push({ nm: 'kakitebing', x: cx, by: yb0, n: W, hmax: 0, dxr: 0, dyr: 0, sp: 0, ao: W });", "", 1), ("ao = shAO(W, H, cxo, ob.by + 1, clamp(sil.bw * .5, I(5), I(20)), clamp(sil.bw * .12, 2, 5), .5, okS, dkS, shm);", "ao = 0;", 1), ("if (CSH) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) for (let k = 1; k < I(4); k++) { const i = (yb0 + k) * W + x;", "if (false) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) for (let k = 1; k < I(4); k++) { const i = (yb0 + k) * W + x;", 1)])

# audit-adegan.py (Tahap 147a; 151a2: siluet juga diperiksa 'bayangan tidak jatuh di benda lain' lewat e.lmask; 151a: memuat adegan `siluet` (langit bukan batu = bukan gm, pohon wajib punya oklusi pangkal); diperketat 149b: cermin memakai topeng batu `e.rock` untuk 'bukan langit' dan menara wajib punya oklusi pangkal): audit pra-adegan bayangan benda statis, SEMUA adegan, Chromium nyata.
# Pakai: python3 audit-adegan.py <berkas.html> [ringkas]   -> mencetak tabel + VONIS
import sys, json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SMALL = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = r'''

for e in r['errs'][:5]: print('ERR', e)

json.dump(r, open('/tmp/audit_'+os.path.basename(f)+'.json','w'))
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not why else 'GAGAL ('+'; '.join(why)+')')

## Tahap 154 (6 Nov 2026, sesi lanjutan): UTANG 152b (adegan `ramp`) dikerjakan atas permintaan pemilik ("kerjakan 152b")

#### 154 (6 Nov 2026): utang 152b butir 1 sampai 4 dikerjakan; `daily-log.html` = v153c (serah, kerja sekali jalan, bukan pola empat tahap karena bukan adegan baru)
- **Basis:** `daily-log.html` v153b (md5 `9977a7bde8224aa5ea129427c2eb189e`). Pola: patch `patch152b.py`, v153b -> v153c.
- **Butir 3 (perapihan visual `ramp`), tangkapan 390x274 enam jam/cuaca DILIHAT sebelum dan sesudah:** (a) bunker: pita beton, tepi tegak, atap putih menjorok, kubah kecil, pintu gelap, bayangan dasar (tidak lagi papan polos); (b) tiang ledakan: rok percikan lebar di dasar, badan hampir lurus dengan tepi kembang kol, tudung membulat di ujung (bukan corong), pencahayaan bergelombang; (c) pantai: 30 puing beragam (batu, cangkang, papan hanyut, karung pasir) dengan bayangan menurut arah matahari, posisi hash 32 bit, ukuran menurut perspektif; (d) bayangan tokoh: bayangan jatuh lebih tebal (alfa x2,5, dua piksel lebar, panjang 1,0) dan bayangan kontak lebih kuat (tiga baris, alfa sampai .78).
- **Butir 1 (komposit eksposur panjang hujan, `ramp_rain.py`):** 80 bingkai, peta lonjakan per piksel; gambar DILIHAT: goresan hujan tersebar acak di seluruh bidang dan miring searah angin, tidak berbaris. Metrik angka (CV sel 13x9 = 1,57; autokorelasi kolom 0,90) TIDAK dipakai sebagai bukti karena didominasi gerak lain (gelembung, tokoh, kilau air); cermin 1,76 dan tangga 1,05 menunjukkan pola yang sama. Utang baru kecil: isolasi hujan lewat `nofx` agar angka bermakna.
- **Butir 2 (mutan suara `ramp`, `mut152s.py` memakai `test153.py`):** S1 resep dikosongkan TERTANGKAP (A2 dan B3), S2 volume x10 TERTANGKAP (B3, -13 dBFS), S3 resep disamakan dengan `tangga` TERTANGKAP (B4), S4 frekuensi NaN membuat uji berhenti dengan galat halaman (tertangkap sebagai kegagalan uji, bukan lolos). Uji suara penuh pada v153c: **VONIS LULUS** (semua A, B, C).
- **Butir 4 (bukti efek dengan/tanpa semua efek `ramp`, `fxp152b.py`, persen piksel berbeda, nilai terbesar dari enam kombinasi jam/cuaca):** ambient 3,16; aoc 0,35; bloom 5,64; cshadow 0,05; dof 1,29; flare 48,91; glit 0,66; refl 1,45; rim 1,69; shafts 7,82. **Semua efek ada dan bekerja** (tidak ada yang 0). `cshadow` kecil karena hanya bayangan tokoh kecil.
- **Audit dan sapuan v153c:** `audit-adegan.py` 64 kombinasi, 0 galat, 16 adegan 0 arah salah dan 0 piksel di langit, `ramp` cerah ch 3,50 / 3,56, selisih terang 26,4, **VONIS LULUS** (adegan lain tidak berubah). Sapuan `ramp` 24 jam x 7 cuaca (168): 0 galat, 0 bingkai kosong; create maksimum sekitar 298 ms, bingkai maksimum sekitar 100 ms (sama dengan sebelum patch, 104 ms).
- **Ceklis aturan adegan (perbaikan adegan lama):** [1 tidak berlaku: bukan adegan baru, ini penyelesaian utang 152b] [2 sampai 4 dipertahankan] [5 dan 6 dipertahankan, hujan dilihat di komposit] [7 dipenuhi: sapuan nol galat dan tangkapan 390x274 dilihat] [8 dipenuhi: bukti 10 efek] [9 tidak berlaku] [10 dipenuhi: puing beragam] [11 dan 12 dipertahankan, bidang depan tidak berubah] [16 dipenuhi: bayangan tokoh diperkuat] [17 dipenuhi: bayangan puing dan bunker menurut matahari] [18 dipenuhi: suara lulus] [nama/sumber tidak disebut: dipenuhi].
- **Utang 152b: SELESAI** (butir 1 sampai 4). **Utang tersisa:** (1) isolasi hujan di komposit lewat `nofx` supaya ada angka bukti; (2) utang T4 adegan `tangga` (kelelawar tipis, waktu bingkai di HP, mutan arah dibalik, warna daun siang); (3) waktu bingkai `ramp` di HP belum diukur.
- **Berkas serah:** `daily-log.html` (v153c, md5 `fe49190c049e4c558e9a38724e0fc7c4`), `PROGRESS-2.md`.
- **BERIKUTNYA:** adegan tetap DIJEDA sesuai permintaan pemilik; bila dilanjut: utang tersisa di atas, lalu adegan ke-22 dengan pola T1 sampai T4.

[214, 168, 138] : [150, 108, 100]; col[(yy - t_) * W + xx] = pk(c[0], c[1], c[2]); } } }
        else if (kind === 3) { for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) { const bx_ = x + (b - 1) * Math.round(s_ * 1.7) + (b === 1 ? Math.round(s_ * .8) : 0), by_ = y - (b === 1 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(s_ * .8)) : 0), rw = Math.max(2, Math.round(s_ * 1.3)), rh = Math.max(1, Math.round(s_ * .75)); if (b === 1 && hh(k, 67) < .35) continue; for (let dy = -rh; dy <= 0; dy++) for (let dx = -rw; dx <= rw; dx++) { if ((dx / rw) ** 2 + (dy / (rh + .5)) ** 2 > 1) continue; const xx = bx_ + dx, yy = by_ + dy; if (xx < 0 || xx >= W || yy <= yb0 || yy >= ysh) continue; const lit = .8 + .3 * (dx * sdn / rw) * .5 + (dy === -rh ? .12 : 0); col[yy * W + xx] = pk(222 * lit, 196 * lit, 150 * lit); } } }
        else { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const xx = x + i, yy = y; if (xx < 0 || xx >= W || yy <= yb0 || yy >= ysh) continue; const c = i ? [255, 232, 238] : [255, 190, 206]; col[yy * W + xx] = pk(c[0], c[1], c[2]); if (yy - 1 > yb0) col[(yy - 1) * W + xx] = pk(255, 244, 246); } } } }
    /* ---- landak baja (hedgehog) bergaris permen""")
# 4. BAYANGAN TOKOH: lebih tebal (jatuh dan kontak)
rep("Ac = clamp(PAR.Ac * 1.7, 0, .85); for (const q of px) { const h = ey - q[1]; if (h < 0) continue; const sx = Math.round(q[0] + d_.dxr * h * .8), sy = Math.round(ey + d_.dyr * h * .8 * .6);",
    "Ac = clamp(PAR.Ac * 2.5, .3, .92); for (const q of px) { const h = ey - q[1]; if (h < 0) continue; for (let w_ = 0; w_ < 2; w_++) { const sx = Math.round(q[0] + d_.dxr * h * 1 + w_), sy = Math.round(ey + d_.dyr * h * 1 * .6);")
rep("if (sx >= 0 && sx < W && sy >= 0 && sy < H && gm[sy * W + sx] === 1) Bd(out, sx, sy, 40, 26, 64, Ac * (1 - .3 * h / hS)); }",
    "if (sx >= 0 && sx < W && sy >= 0 && sy < H && gm[sy * W + sx] === 1) Bd(out, sx, sy, 40, 26, 64, Ac * (1 - .3 * h / hS)); } }")
rep("for (let dx = -Math.ceil(hS * .3); dx <= Math.ceil(hS * .3); dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) Bd(out, fx + dx, ey + 1 + dy, 40, 26, 64, .5 * (dy ? .6 : 1) * (1 - Math.abs(dx) / (hS * .4))); }",
    "for (let dx = -Math.ceil(hS * .4); dx <= Math.ceil(hS * .4); dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) Bd(out, fx + dx, ey + 1 + dy, 40, 26, 64, .78 * (dy === 0 ? 1 : dy === 1 ? .8 : .45) * (1 - Math.abs(dx) / (hS * .5))); }")
open(sys.argv[2], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s); print('ok', len(s))

```ramp_rain.py
# ramp_rain.py: komposit eksposur panjang hujan adegan (utang 152b butir 1). Pakai: python3 ramp_rain.py <berkas.html> [adegan]
import sys, os, json, base64
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SC = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'ramp'
JS = '''async (sc) => { const W=390,H=274,N=80; const e=window.DL.pxbg.create({scene:sc,W,H,min:780,wx:'rain',seed:5}); const o=new Uint32Array(W*H); const fr=[];
 for(let k=0;k<N;k++){ e.frame(k*.1,o); const l=new Uint8Array(W*H); for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++){const c=o[i]; l[i]=(.3*(c&255)+.59*((c>>8)&255)+.11*((c>>16)&255))|0} fr.push(l); }
 const spike=new Uint16Array(W*H), mx=new Uint8Array(W*H); const tmp=new Uint8Array(N);
 for(let i=0;i<W*H;i++){ for(let k=0;k<N;k++)tmp[k]=fr[k][i]; const s=Array.from(tmp).sort((a,b)=>a-b), med=s[N>>1]; let c=0; for(let k=0;k<N;k++) if(tmp[k]-med>28)c++; spike[i]=c; mx[i]=s[N-1]; }
 const GX=13,GY=9,cells=new Float64Array(GX*GY); for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++)cells[((y*GY/H)|0)*GX+((x*GX/W)|0)]+=spike[y*W+x];
 const cv=a=>{const m=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+q,0)/a.length;const v=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+(q-m)*(q-m),0)/a.length;return m?Math.sqrt(v)/m:0};
 const cols=new Float64Array(W),rows=new Float64Array(H); for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){cols[x]+=spike[y*W+x];rows[y]+=spike[y*W+x]}
 const ac=(a,L)=>{const m=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+q,0)/a.length;let n=0,d=0;for(let i=0;i<a.length-L;i++)n+=(a[i]-m)*(a[i+L]-m);for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)d+=(a[i]-m)**2;return d?n/d:0};
 let tot=0;for(const v of spike)tot+=v;
 let best=0;for(let L=3;L<60;L++)best=Math.max(best,Math.abs(ac(cols,L)));
 const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=H;const x=c.getContext('2d');const im=x.createImageData(W,H);for(let i=0;i<W*H;i++){const v=Math.min(255,spike[i]*70);im.data[i*4]=v;im.data[i*4+1]=v;im.data[i*4+2]=v;im.data[i*4+3]=255}x.putImageData(im,0,0);
 return {tot,cvGrid:cv(cells),acKolomMax:best,png:c.toDataURL('image/png')}; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':780}); pg.goto('file://'+os.path.abspath(f), wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    r = pg.evaluate(JS, SC); b.close()
open('rain_%s.png' % SC, 'wb').write(base64.b64decode(r['png'].split(',')[1]))
print(SC, 'piksel-lonjakan', r['tot'], 'CV sel 13x9', round(r['cvGrid'], 2), 'autokorelasi kolom maks', round(r['acKolomMax'], 3))
```
```fxp152b.py
import os, json, sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = sys.argv[1]; SC = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'ramp'
FXS = sys.argv[3].split(',') if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ['ambient','aoc','bloom','cshadow','dof','flare','glit','refl','rim','shafts']
JS = '''async (a) => { const [sc,FXS]=a,W=390,H=274,res={}; const R=(nf,mn,wx)=>{const e=window.DL.pxbg.create({scene:sc,W,H,min:mn,wx,seed:3,nofx:nf});const o=new Uint32Array(W*H);for(const t of [0,.5,1,1.5])e.frame(t,o);return o};
 for(const fx of FXS){ let best=0,at=''; for(const [mn,wx] of [[780,'clear'],[960,'clear'],[1230,'clear'],[1320,'clear'],[780,'rain'],[1090,'cloud']]){ const A=R([],mn,wx),B=R([fx],mn,wx); let d=0; for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++) if(A[i]!==B[i]) d++; const p=100*d/A.length; if(p>best){best=p;at=mn+'/'+wx} } res[fx]=[+best.toFixed(2),at]; } return res }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:

    r = pg.evaluate(JS, [SC, FXS]); b.close()

```mut152s.py
# mut152s.py: mutan cepat suara adegan ramp (utang 152b butir 2). Pakai: python3 mut152s.py <berkas.html>  (test153.py harus ada di folder yang sama)
import sys, os, re, subprocess, concurrent.futures as cf
base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))
mr = re.search(r"    ramp\(c\) \{.*?\},\n", base); mt = re.search(r"    tangga\(c\) \{.*?\},\n", base); assert mr and mt
rampL, tanggaL = mr.group(0), mt.group(0)
M = [('S1_ramp_diam', rampL, "    ramp(c) { },\n"),
     ('S2_ramp_keras', rampL, rampL.replace("g: .34", "g: 3.4", 1).replace("g: .09", "g: .9", 1)),
     ('S3_ramp_sama_tangga', rampL, tanggaL.replace("tangga(c)", "ramp(c)", 1)),
     ('S4_ramp_nan', rampL, rampL.replace("hz: 75", "hz: NaN", 1))]
def go(m):
    n, a, b = m; s = base.replace(a, b, 1); assert s != base; p = os.path.join(D, 'mut_%s.html' % n); open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'test153.py', p], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=D); os.remove(p)
    v = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('VONIS')]; g = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('GAGAL')]
    return n, ('TERTANGKAP: ' + '; '.join(x[:60] for x in g[:2])) if v and 'GAGAL' in v[0] else (v[0] if v else 'ERR ' + r.stderr[-150:])
with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as ex:
    for n, v in ex.map(go, M): print(n, '->', v)

# (151a: A1 diubah dari 18 ke 19 adegan)
# test148a.py: uji suara adegan 148a. Pakai: python3 test148a.py <berkas.html> [cepat]
import sys, os, json, itertools
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]); quick = len(sys.argv) > 2
fails = []
def chk(name, ok, info=''):
    print(('OK   ' if ok else 'GAGAL'), name, info)
    if not ok: fails.append(name)
STAT = r'''() => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = { bad: [], keys: {}, empty: [], evbad: [], birdsNight: [], birdsRain: [], sceneJson: {}, wxSame: [], phSame: [], duskSame: [], dawnSame: [] };
 const WX = ['clear','cloud','fog','rain','storm','snow'], MIN = [360, 780, 1080, 1320], sc = S.scenes();
 for (const s of sc) for (const m of MIN) for (const w of WX) { const r = S.recipe(s, m, w); if (!r) { out.empty.push([s, m, w]); continue; }
  const num = [r.vol, r.lp]; r.beds.forEach(L => num.push(L.g, L.hz, L.f === undefined ? 1 : L.f)); r.ev.forEach(E => { num.push(E.r, E.g); if (!S.EV.includes(E.k)) out.evbad.push([s, E.k]); });
  if (num.some(x => !isFinite(x) || x < 0) || r.vol <= 0 || r.vol > 1.2 || !r.beds.length) out.bad.push([s, m, w]);
  if (r.ph === 'night' && r.ev.some(E => E.k === 'bird')) out.birdsNight.push([s, m, w]);
  if ((w === 'rain' || w === 'storm' || w === 'snow') && r.ev.some(E => E.k === 'bird' || E.k === 'cricket')) out.birdsRain.push([s, m, w]);
  if (m === 780 && w === 'clear') out.sceneJson[s] = JSON.stringify([r.beds, r.ev]); }
 for (const s of sc) { if (s === 'akuarium') continue; const a = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').ev]), b = JSON.stringify([S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').beds, S.recipe(s, 780, 'rain').ev]); if (a === b) out.wxSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['airterjun','padang','dusun','danau','embun','atap']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear').ev), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 1320, 'clear').ev); if (a === b) out.phSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 1080, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.duskSame.push(s); }
 for (const s of ['padang','danau','dusun']) { const a = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 780, 'clear')), b = JSON.stringify(S.recipe(s, 360, 'clear')); if (a === b) out.dawnSame.push(s); }
 out.n = sc.length; out.uniq = new Set(Object.values(out.sceneJson)).size; return out; }'''
OFF = r'''async (cases) => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = {};
 const fft = (re, im) => { const n = re.length; for (let i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) { let b = n >> 1; for (; j & b; b >>= 1) j ^= b; j ^= b; if (i < j) { [re[i], re[j]] = [re[j], re[i]]; [im[i], im[j]] = [im[j], im[i]]; } }
  for (let len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) { const a = -2 * Math.PI / len, wr = Math.cos(a), wi = Math.sin(a); for (let i = 0; i < n; i += len) { let cr = 1, ci = 0; for (let j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) { const ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j], vr = re[i + j + len / 2] * cr - im[i + j + len / 2] * ci, vi = re[i + j + len / 2] * ci + im[i + j + len / 2] * cr; re[i + j] = ur + vr; im[i + j] = ui + vi; re[i + j + len / 2] = ur - vr; im[i + j + len / 2] = ui - vi; const t = cr * wr - ci * wi; ci = cr * wi + ci * wr; cr = t; } } } };
 const EDG = [60, 120, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3500, 5500, 9000, 16000];
 for (const [sc, m, wx] of cases) { const d = await S.render(sc, m, wx, 5, 7); let s2 = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const v = d[i]; if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } s2 += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); }
  const N = 4096, bands = new Float64Array(EDG.length - 1); for (let o = 0; o + N <= d.length; o += N * 2) { const re = new Float64Array(N), im = new Float64Array(N); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) re[i] = d[o + i] * (.5 - .5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / N)); fft(re, im); for (let k = 1; k < N / 2; k++) { const fr = k * 44100 / N; for (let b = 0; b < EDG.length - 1; b++) if (fr >= EDG[b] && fr < EDG[b + 1]) { bands[b] += re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k]; break; } } }
  const tot = bands.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1; out[sc + '|' + m + '|' + wx] = { rms: 20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(s2 / d.length) + 1e-9), pk, nan, bands: Array.from(bands, b => b / tot) }; }
 return out; }'''
INIT = "window.__osc=0;window.__bs=0;const A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(A){const o=A.prototype.createOscillator,b=A.prototype.createBufferSource;A.prototype.createOscillator=function(){window.__osc++;return o.call(this)};A.prototype.createBufferSource=function(){window.__bs++;return b.call(this)};}"
with sync_playwright() as p:
    br = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'])
    ctx = br.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}); ctx.add_init_script(INIT); pg = ctx.new_page(); perr = []
    pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + f, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
    # --- A statik
    st = pg.evaluate(STAT)
    chk('A1 21 adegan punya resep', st['n'] == 21 and not st['empty'], st['n'])
    chk('A2 angka sah semua resep', not st['bad'], st['bad'][:3])
    chk('A3 semua jenis kejadian ada', not st['evbad'], st['evbad'][:3])
    chk('A4 resep tiap adegan unik', st['uniq'] == st['n'], st['uniq'])
    chk('A5 cuaca mengubah resep', not st['wxSame'], st['wxSame'])
    chk('A6 jam mengubah resep adegan bernyawa', not st['phSame'], st['phSame'])
    chk('A9 senja dan fajar beda dari siang', not st['duskSame'] and not st['dawnSame'], [st['duskSame'], st['dawnSame']])
    chk('A7 tanpa burung saat malam', not st['birdsNight'], st['birdsNight'][:3])
    chk('A8 tanpa burung/jangkrik saat hujan/badai/salju', not st['birdsRain'], st['birdsRain'][:3])
    # --- B luring
    sc = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.scenes()')
    cases = [[s, 780, 'clear'] for s in sc] + ([] if quick else [[s, m, w] for s in sc for m, w in [(1320, 'rain'), (1320, 'storm'), (360, 'fog'), (600, 'snow')]])
    r = pg.evaluate(OFF, cases)
    nan = [k for k, v in r.items() if v['nan']]; pk = [(k, round(v['pk'], 2)) for k, v in r.items() if v['pk'] > .9]
    lo = [(k, round(v['rms'], 1)) for k, v in r.items() if v['rms'] < -50 or v['rms'] > -22]
    chk('B1 tanpa NaN', not nan, nan[:3]); chk('B2 puncak < 0,9 (tidak pecah)', not pk, pk[:3]); chk('B3 kekerasan -50..-22 dBFS', not lo, lo[:4])
    cl = {k.split('|')[0]: v['bands'] for k, v in r.items() if k.endswith('|780|clear')}; names = list(cl); md = 9
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(names, 2):
        d = sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(cl[a], cl[b])); md = min(md, d)
        if d < .08: print('   dekat:', a, b, round(d, 3))

        wd = [s for s in sc if s != 'akuarium' and sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(r[s + '|780|clear']['bands'], r[s + '|1320|rain']['bands'])) < .03 and abs(r[s + '|780|clear']['rms'] - r[s + '|1320|rain']['rms']) < .8]
        chk('B5 hujan terdengar beda dari cerah', not wd, wd)
        sq = [s for s in sc if r[s + '|600|snow']['rms'] > r[s + '|780|clear']['rms'] + 3]
        chk('B6 salju tidak lebih keras dari cerah', not sq, sq)
    # --- C langsung
    s0 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')

    chk('C2 tombol speaker ada, aria-pressed=false', pg.evaluate("(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#hxSky>.sndbtn');return !!b&&b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='false'})()"))
    sk0 = pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.contains('skyfocus')")

    if on_now: pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)

    chk('C14 dimatikan: gain 0, ctx suspended, tersimpan "0"', (not s2['on']) and s2['gain'] < .03 and s2['ctx'] == 'suspended' and pg.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('dailylog:snd:on')") == '0', s2)
    pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(800)   # nyalakan lagi lalu muat ulang
    pg.reload(wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(2200)
    s3 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')

  const sp=new Uint8Array(W*H),t=new Uint8Array(N);for(let i=0;i<W*H;i++){for(let k=0;k<N;k++)t[k]=fr[k][i];const s=Array.from(t).sort((a,b)=>a-b),m=s[N>>1];let c=0;for(let k=0;k<N;k++)if(t[k]-m>28)c++;sp[i]=c}return sp};
 const R=run('rain'),C=run('clear'),ok=new Uint8Array(W*H);let nok=0;for(let i=0;i<W*H;i++)if(!C[i]){ok[i]=1;nok++}
 const cv=a=>{const m=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+q,0)/a.length,v=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+(q-m)**2,0)/a.length;return m?Math.sqrt(v)/m:0};
 const ac=(a,L)=>{const m=a.reduce((p,q)=>p+q,0)/a.length;let n=0,d=0;for(let i=0;i<a.length-L;i++)n+=(a[i]-m)*(a[i+L]-m);for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)d+=(a[i]-m)**2;return d?n/d:0};
 const met=(M)=>{const cells=new Float64Array(GX*GY),cols=new Float64Array(W);let tot=0;for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){const v=M[y*W+x];if(!v)continue;tot+=v;cells[((y*GY/H)|0)*GX+((x*GX/W)|0)]+=v;cols[x]+=v}let b=0;for(let L=3;L<60;L++)b=Math.max(b,Math.abs(ac(cols,L)));return{tot,cv:cv(cells),ac:b}};
 let sd=12345;const rnd=()=>(sd=(sd*1664525+1013904223)>>>0)/4294967296;
 const mk=(g)=>{const M=new Uint8Array(W*H);let n=0;while(n<5000){const x=(rnd()*W)|0,y=(rnd()*H)|0;const xx=g?(x-x%g):x;if(ok[y*W+xx]){M[y*W+xx]=1;n++}}return M};
 const onlyRain=new Uint8Array(W*H);for(let i=0;i<W*H;i++)if(ok[i])onlyRain[i]=R[i];
 const cap=(M)=>{let n=0;const o=new Uint8Array(W*H);for(let i=0;i<W*H&&n<5000;i++)if(M[i]){o[i]=M[i];n++}return o};

## Tahap 156 (6 Nov 2026, sesi lanjutan): SUARA ADEGAN, tiap adegan khas tanpa bunyi yang diulang, hanya aktif di mode animasi ketuk 3x (adegan baru DIJEDA)

#### 156 (6 Nov 2026): `daily-log.html` = v155 (md5 `c18e95a67566ad538c6d377e644220a2`); basis v153c (md5 `fe49190c049e4c558e9a38724e0fc7c4`)
- **Permintaan pemilik (apa adanya):** "suaranya tiap scene harus beda dan suaranya jangan generik, harus natural, jelas, dan harus pas dengan scenenya.. jangan ada suara yang diulang. dan suara hanya aktif bila masuk mode animasi ketuk 3x". Bukan adegan baru, jadi gerbang adegan tidak berlaku.
- **Perubahan (`patch155.py`, v153c -> v155, 12 penggantian, tiap jangkar tepat sekali, hasil deterministik; 3 blok script lolos `node --check`):**
  1. **Gerbang mode animasi:** suara hanya jalan bila `#v-home` punya kelas `skyfocus` (ketuk 3x). Masuk mode = suara menyala OTOMATIS (ketukan ketiga adalah gestur pengguna; `flip()` mengirim peristiwa `dl:skyfocus`); keluar mode = diam, `AudioContext` ditangguhkan. Tombol speaker kini hanya tampil di mode animasi dan berfungsi sebagai BISUKAN (pilihan di `dailylog:snd:on`; bawaan sekarang MENYALA di mode animasi, hanya `0` yang berarti bisu). Di luar mode tidak ada `AudioContext`.
  2. **Satu jenis bunyi kejadian = satu adegan:** tabel `OWN` (bunyi lama yang dipertahankan di satu adegan: elang pegunungan, ketukan rel kereta, gelembung akuarium, klakson atap, jam/halaman/derit perpus, klakson kabut dan camar mercu, tetes embun, kodok danau, burung hantu dan gagak siluet, lonceng dusun, jangkrik padang, kicau embun) dan `SIGN` (bunyi khas BARU per adegan). Bunyi bersama di adegan lain dibuang. 20 jenis bunyi baru disintesis dengan Web Audio: cebur batu (air terjun), kicau lerak melengking (padang), ayam jantan (dusun), tempaan landasan (kastil), rintihan burung selam (danau, malam), kerikil jatuh (reruntuhan), cicit burung pantai (pantai), gemeretak ombak surut di kerikil (pantai), peluit kereta tiga nada, dekut merpati (atap), desis wajan dan denting (lorong), lonceng kapal dua pukulan, genderang taiko (gerbang), denting kaca (cermin), dentum jauh (ramp), tetes sumur dengan gema dan cicit kelelawar (tangga), salakan anjing jauh (dusun, malam), lompat ikan (danau, siang), lolongan jauh (pegunungan, malam). Cuaca (hujan, petir) tetap bunyi bersama menurut fisika, ditambah sesudah penyaringan.
- **UJI (`t155.py`, Chromium nyata, tanpa jaringan): VONIS LULUS.** A: 21 adegan; tiap jenis bunyi (cerah, 4 jam) milik SATU adegan; saat hujan/salju/kabut/mendung tidak ada bunyi non-cuaca yang dipakai bersama; tiap adegan punya bunyi khas; 32 jenis bunyi berbeda. B1: render 21 adegan x (siang cerah, malam cerah, malam hujan) x 2 seed x 12 detik: tanpa NaN, puncak < 0,9, kekerasan -50..-22 dBFS. C: di luar mode animasi tanpa `AudioContext` dan gain 0 (juga setelah klik); tombol tersembunyi; ketuk 3x nyata (klik) masuk mode, suara menyala otomatis (running, gain 0,34), tombol muncul, kejadian bunyi terus terjadwal; ketuk 3x lagi keluar mode, diam, `suspended`; masuk lagi bersuara; tombol membisukan dan menyimpan `0`, tekan lagi bersuara; pindah halaman diam; nol galat halaman. `gap155.py`: tidak ada adegan x jam (cerah) tanpa kejadian bunyi (sebelumnya dusun malam, danau siang, pantai malam, pegunungan malam kosong; uji C6 menangkap pantai malam, ditambal sebelum serah).
- **YANG TIDAK TERBUKTI / BATAS (jujur):** (1) **BELUM ADA YANG MENDENGAR**: "natural, jelas, pas" dinilai dari rancangan sintesis dan angka (tidak pecah, tidak sunyi), bukan telinga; 20 bunyi sintetis bisa terdengar buatan, terutama ayam jantan, lolongan, dan salakan; mohon didengarkan di HP dan sebut yang terdengar aneh. (2) **Lapisan dasar (gemuruh air, angin, ombak) tidak dijamin unik per adegan** dan tidak diubah; uji jarak spektrum lama (B4) TIDAK dijalankan ulang karena `test153.py` tidak ada di unggahan. (3) Bunyi cuaca (hujan, petir) sama di semua adegan luar ruangan menurut desain. (4) Uji suara lama (`test153.py`: C1 \"bawaan MATI\", C14 dst) kini usang karena bawaan berubah; belum ditulis ulang. (5) Mutan TIDAK dijalankan. (6) Kekerasan tiap bunyi baru relatif terhadap lapisan dasar belum dikalibrasi lewat `CAL` (hanya batas -50..-22 dBFS lulus). (7) HP nyata, Safari/WebKit tidak diuji (pembukaan `AudioContext` lewat ketukan ketiga diharapkan jalan di sana, belum dibuktikan).
- **Berkas serah:** `daily-log.html` (v155), `PROGRESS-2.md`. Alat uji tercatat di bawah; mengulang: `python3 patch155.py <v153c.html> OUT.html`, `python3 t155.py OUT.html`.
- **BERIKUTNYA:** dengarkan di HP lalu laporkan; utang: kalibrasi `CAL` per bunyi baru, mutan cepat, tulis ulang `test153.py`; adegan tetap DIJEDA (utang `tangga` dan `ramp` dari Tahap 155 tetap terbuka).

  const OWN = { eagle: 'pegunungan', clack: 'kereta', bubble: 'akuarium', horn1: 'atap', tick: 'perpus', page: 'perpus', creak: 'perpus', horn: 'mercu', gull: 'mercu', drip: 'embun', frog: 'danau', owl: 'siluet', crow: 'siluet', bell: 'dusun', cricket: 'padang', bird: 'embun' };

    kereta(c) { c.e({ k: 'whistle', r: .014, g: .03, lp: 2600 }); },
    atap(c) { if (c.bf > 0) c.e({ k: 'coo', r: .1 * c.bf, g: .03, lp: 1200 }); },
    lorong(c) { c.e({ k: 'wok', r: c.ph === 'night' ? .07 : .03, g: .035 }); },
    kapal(c) { c.e({ k: 'shipbell', r: .03, g: .05, lp: 6000 }); },
    gerbang(c) { c.e({ k: 'taiko', r: .04, g: .05, lp: 1500 }); },
    cermin(c) { c.e({ k: 'glass', r: .07, g: .028 }); },

```t155.py
# t155.py: uji suara adegan v155. Pakai: python3 t155.py <html>
import sys, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]); fails = []
def chk(n, ok, i=''):
    print('OK   ' if ok else 'GAGAL', n, i)
    if not ok: fails.append(n)
KINDS = '''() => { const S = window.DL.snd, sc = S.scenes(), own = {}, per = {}, weather = new Set(['drip','thunder']), shared = [], rainShared = [];
 for (const s of sc) { per[s] = new Set(); for (const m of [360,780,1080,1320]) { const r = S.recipe(s, m, 'clear'); r.ev.forEach(E => per[s].add(E.k)); } }
 for (const s of sc) per[s].forEach(k => { (own[k] = own[k] || []).push(s); });
 for (const k in own) if (own[k].length > 1) shared.push([k, own[k]]);
 const rk = {}; for (const s of sc) for (const m of [360,780,1080,1320]) for (const w of ['rain','storm','snow','fog','cloud']) { const r = S.recipe(s, m, w); r.ev.forEach(E => { if (weather.has(E.k)) return; (rk[E.k] = rk[E.k] || new Set()).add(s); }); }
 for (const k in rk) if (rk[k].size > 1) rainShared.push([k, [...rk[k]]]);
 const none = sc.filter(s => !per[s].size); return { n: sc.length, shared, rainShared, none, per: Object.fromEntries(sc.map(s => [s, [...per[s]]])) }; }'''
REND = '''async () => { const S = window.DL.snd, out = [], bad = []; for (const s of S.scenes()) for (const [m, w] of [[780,'clear'],[1320,'clear'],[1320,'rain']]) for (const seed of [7, 19]) { const d = await S.render(s, m, w, 12, seed); let e = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (const v of d) { if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } e += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); } const db = 20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(e / d.length) + 1e-9); if (nan || pk > .9 || db < -50 || db > -22) bad.push([s, m, w, seed, +db.toFixed(1), +pk.toFixed(2), nan]); } return bad; }'''
with sync_playwright() as p:
    br = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'])
    pg = br.new_page(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file://' + f, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
    k = pg.evaluate(KINDS)
    chk('A1 21 adegan', k['n'] == 21, k['n']); chk('A2 tiap jenis bunyi (cerah, 4 jam) milik SATU adegan', not k['shared'], k['shared'])
    chk('A3 hujan/salju/kabut/mendung: tak ada bunyi non-cuaca yang dipakai bersama', not k['rainShared'], k['rainShared'])
    chk('A4 tiap adegan punya bunyi khas', not k['none'], k['none'])
    chk('A5 ada 15+ jenis bunyi berbeda', len({x for v in k['per'].values() for x in v}) >= 24, len({x for v in k['per'].values() for x in v}))
    bad = pg.evaluate(REND); chk('B1 render 21 adegan x 3 kondisi x 2 seed: tanpa NaN, tidak pecah, -50..-22 dBFS', not bad, bad[:5])
    # --- gerbang mode animasi
    s0 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()'); pg.mouse.click(200, 700); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); s1 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C1 di luar mode animasi: tak ada AudioContext, gain 0', s0['ctx'] == 'none' and s1['ctx'] == 'none' and s1['gain'] < .03, [s0['ctx'], s1])
    vis = lambda: pg.evaluate("(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#hxSky>.sndbtn');return b?getComputedStyle(b).display:'tak ada'})()")
    chk('C2 tombol suara tersembunyi di luar mode animasi', vis() in ('none', 'tak ada'), vis())
    bb = pg.evaluate("(()=>{const r=document.getElementById('hxSky').getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x,r.y,r.width,r.height]})()")
    X, Y = bb[0] + 24, bb[1] + bb[3] - 22
    for _ in range(3): pg.mouse.click(X, Y); pg.wait_for_timeout(90)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(3200); sk = pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.contains('skyfocus')"); s2 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C3 ketuk 3x masuk mode animasi', sk)
    chk('C4 masuk mode: suara menyala OTOMATIS (ctx running, gain naik)', s2['ctx'] == 'running' and s2['gain'] > .25, s2)
    chk('C5 tombol suara muncul di mode animasi', vis() != 'none', vis())
    pg.wait_for_timeout(2500); e1 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state().ev'); pg.wait_for_timeout(15000); e2 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state().ev')
    chk('C6 kejadian bunyi terjadwal terus di mode animasi', e2 > e1, (e1, e2))
    for _ in range(3): pg.mouse.click(X, Y); pg.wait_for_timeout(90)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(3800); sk2 = pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('v-home').classList.contains('skyfocus')"); s3 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C7 ketuk 3x lagi: keluar mode, suara diam, ctx suspended', (not sk2) and s3['gain'] < .03 and s3['ctx'] == 'suspended', s3)
    for _ in range(3): pg.mouse.click(X, Y); pg.wait_for_timeout(90)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(3200); chk('C8 masuk lagi: bersuara lagi', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] > .25)
    pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3000); s4 = pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')
    chk('C9 tombol di mode animasi = bisukan; tersimpan', (not s4['on']) and s4['gain'] < .03 and pg.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('dailylog:snd:on')") == '0', s4)
    pg.click('#hxSky>.sndbtn'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3000); chk('C10 tombol lagi = bersuara', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] > .25)
    pg.click('button[data-view="train"]'); pg.wait_for_timeout(3500); chk('C11 pindah halaman: diam', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.state()')['gain'] < .03)
    chk('D1 tanpa galat halaman', not perr, perr[:3]); br.close()
print('VONIS:', 'LULUS' if not fails else 'GAGAL ' + ', '.join(fails))

## Tahap 157 (6 Nov 2026, sesi lanjutan): BACKSOUND MUSIK per adegan, CONTOH 4 adegan (pantai, kastil, danau, tangga); adegan baru tetap DIJEDA

#### 157 (6 Nov 2026): `daily-log.html` = v156 (md5 `827e81a52baba0dce9f48078b4d482c2`); basis v155 (md5 `c18e95a67566ad538c6d377e644220a2`)
- **Permintaan pemilik:** "boleh, saran kamu udh oke semua musik volumenya di bawah suara scene, coba buat contohnya dlu". Saran yang disetujui: musik jarang dan lembut, selalu di bawah suara adegan, mengecil sebentar tiap bunyi kejadian, mengecil di cuaca buruk, tanpa berkas audio (sintesis kode), skala/tempo/warna berbeda per adegan; tombol terpisah dan nada bunyi bernada ditala ke musik ditanyakan/ditunda.
- **Dibuat (`patch157m.py`, v155 -> v156, 9 penggantian tepat sekali, 3 blok script lolos `node --check`):** mesin musik di dalam modul suara (ikut gerbang mode animasi, tombol speaker membisukan musik dan suara bersama, ditangguhkan bersama `AudioContext`). Tiap adegan bermusik = tabel `MUS` (nada dasar, skala, jarak antar nada, suara, gain `lv`): **pantai** G pentatonik mayor, petikan sinus lembut; **kastil** D dorian, nada segitiga pelan menyapu; **danau** A pentatonik minor, suara seperti seruling bervibrato; **tangga** C frigia-minor, petikan jarang dengan gema. Lapisan pad dua osilator sinus berdetune bergoyang pelan; melodi berjalan acak langkah-demi-langkah di dua oktaf; malam = nada dasar turun dan jarak lebih panjang, siang lebih rapat. **Ducking:** tiap bunyi kejadian (kecuali tetes hujan) menurunkan musik ke 42 persen lalu naik pelan. **Cuaca:** hujan/badai musik x0,5, salju/kabut x0,8. Pergantian adegan/jam: musik lama memudar 2,5 dtk, baru muncul 4 dtk. 17 adegan lain BELUM bermusik (musik kosong).
- **Contoh didengar tanpa membuka aplikasi (WAV mono 22,05 kHz, 20 dtk, dinormalkan sama untuk tiap pasangan):** `contoh-pantai-musik.wav`, `contoh-pantai-tanpa-musik.wav` (pembanding), `contoh-pantai-musik-hujan.wav`, `contoh-kastil-musik.wav` (malam), `contoh-danau-musik.wav` (senja), `contoh-tangga-musik.wav`. Keras relatif antar berkas tidak sama dengan di aplikasi (dinormalkan), tetapi perbandingan musik vs suara di dalam satu berkas sama dengan aplikasi.
- **UJI (`mix157.py`, Chromium nyata, render luring):** musik saja vs suara adegan saja: pantai 9,2 dB, kastil 9,0, danau 9,2, tangga 9,3, pantai hujan 15,6 (syarat >= 6 dB, DIPASANG dengan `lv` per adegan; tanpa itu kastil hanya 2,8 dB karena suara kastil pelan); puncak campuran <= 0,20; tanpa NaN; adegan tanpa musik (perpus) tetap sama; tanpa galat halaman. Regresi `t155.py` (21 adegan: tak ada bunyi dipakai bersama, render, gerbang mode animasi ketuk 3x nyata): **LULUS**.
- **YANG TIDAK TERBUKTI / BATAS (jujur):** (1) **BELUM ADA YANG MENDENGAR**: enak atau terdengar murahan/sintetis hanya bisa dinilai pemilik; (2) ducking hanya dipasang dan tidak diukur (tidak ada uji angka mengecilnya musik saat bunyi kejadian); (3) jalur LANGSUNG (musik muncul di aplikasi saat ganti adegan/jam) hanya diuji tidak menimbulkan galat dan lewat render luring, belum diperiksa bahwa musik benar-benar berbunyi di aplikasi; (4) nada bunyi bernada (lonceng kapal, peluit, lolongan, dll) BELUM ditala ke nada dasar musik, bisa sumbang; (5) tombol musik terpisah dari suara BELUM ada (speaker membisukan keduanya); (6) hanya 4 dari 21 adegan; (7) mutan tidak dijalankan; (8) HP nyata/Safari tidak diuji.
- **Berkas serah:** `daily-log.html` (v156), `PROGRESS-2.md`, 6 berkas `contoh-*.wav`. Mengulang: `python3 patch157m.py <v155.html> OUT.html`, `python3 mix157.py OUT.html tulis`, `python3 t155.py OUT.html`.
- **BERIKUTNYA:** tunggu penilaian pemilik atas contoh; bila disetujui: musik 17 adegan sisanya, tombol musik terpisah, tala bunyi bernada, ukur ducking, mutan cepat.

# mix157.py: ukur musik vs suara adegan; tulis contoh WAV. Pakai: python3 mix157.py <html> [tulis]
import sys, os, base64, struct, wave
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
f = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]); wr = len(sys.argv) > 2
JS = '''async ([sc, m, wx, sec]) => { const S = window.DL.snd, st = a => { let e = 0, pk = 0, nan = 0; for (const v of a) { if (!isFinite(v)) { nan++; continue; } e += v * v; if (Math.abs(v) > pk) pk = Math.abs(v); } return [20 * Math.log10(Math.sqrt(e / a.length) + 1e-9), pk, nan]; };
 const A = await S.renderMix(sc, m, wx, sec, 7, 'scene'), B = await S.renderMix(sc, m, wx, sec, 7, 'both'), M = await S.renderMix(sc, m, wx, sec, 7, 'music');
 const q = (a, g) => { const o = new Int16Array(a.length >> 1); for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) o[i] = Math.max(-32767, Math.min(32767, Math.round(g * (a[2*i] + a[2*i+1]) / 2 * 32767))); let s = ''; const u = new Uint8Array(o.buffer); for (let i = 0; i < u.length; i += 8192) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u.subarray(i, i + 8192)); return btoa(s); };
 const pk = Math.max(st(B)[1], st(A)[1]), g = .85 / pk; return { sc: st(A), mix: st(B), mus: st(M), b64mix: q(B, g), b64sc: q(A, g) }; }'''
C = [('pantai', 780, 'clear'), ('kastil', 1320, 'clear'), ('danau', 1080, 'clear'), ('tangga', 780, 'clear'), ('pantai', 780, 'rain'), ('perpus', 780, 'clear')]
bad = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); perr = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e))); pg.goto('file://' + f, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    print('adegan bermusik:', pg.evaluate('window.DL.snd.musKeys()'))
    for sc, m, wx in C:
        r = pg.evaluate(JS, [sc, m, wx, 20]); d = r['sc'][0] - r['mus'][0]
        print('%-8s %-5s suara %.1f dBFS | musik saja %.1f dBFS | selisih %.1f dB | puncak campuran %.2f NaN %d' % (sc, wx, r['sc'][0], r['mus'][0], d, r['mix'][1], r['mix'][2]))
        if sc != 'perpus' and (d < 6 or r['mix'][1] > .9 or r['mix'][2]): bad.append((sc, wx, round(d, 1)))
        if wr and sc != 'perpus' and wx == 'clear' or (wr and sc == 'pantai'):
            for tag, k in (('musik', 'b64mix'), ('tanpa-musik', 'b64sc')):
                if tag == 'tanpa-musik' and not (sc == 'pantai' and wx == 'clear'): continue
                fn = 'contoh-%s-%s%s.wav' % (sc, tag, '-hujan' if wx == 'rain' else ''); raw = base64.b64decode(r[k])
                with wave.open(fn, 'wb') as w: w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(22050); w.writeframes(raw)
    print('galat halaman:', perr[:2]); b.close()
print('VONIS musik di bawah suara >= 6 dB, tidak pecah:', 'LULUS' if not bad else 'GAGAL %s' % bad)

## Tahap 158 (6 Nov 2026, sesi lanjutan): MUSIK adegan dicatat (lagu perpaduan Minecraft + Stardew, transisi halus), SUARA OMBAK dan HUJAN diganti

#### 158 (6 Nov 2026): `daily-log.html` = v158 (md5 `aa148ef0cf2fcc3cd1843a6a2282f448`, 3441764 byte); basis v156 (md5 `827e81a52baba0dce9f48078b4d482c2`)
- **Permintaan pemilik (urut):** (1) \"ganti musiknya seperti musik stardew valley dan minecraft, ambil inspirasi dari 2 musik itu tipe dan contohnya\" -> contoh gaya Stardew dan gaya Minecraft per adegan (disetujui, \"sudah bagus\"). (2) \"lebih kaya, jangan cuma satu instrumen, saya mau dengarkan lagu hasil dari keduanya\" -> lagu utuh 49 sampai 65 detik per adegan, disetujui (\"udah oke\"). (3) \"tambah dikit untuk transisi dari musik bagian minecraft ke bagian stardew dibuat lebih smooth\". (4) \"suara ombak dan hujan direvisi jadi lebih bagus, soalnya mirip radio yang tidak dapat sinyal\". (5) \"input dulu yang musik ini ke dalam progress, dan jangan lupa genre musiknya tergantung scene yang dibuat, buat juga nanti tombol yang cuma mematikan musiknya\".
- **Keputusan musik (dicatat sebagai aturan 19 di bagian aturan):** musik disintesis dari kode, nada karangan baru (terinspirasi GAYA, bukan salinan lagu), genre/warna tergantung adegan, di bawah suara adegan (sekitar 9 dB), tombol musik terpisah WAJIB tetapi BELUM dibuat.
- **Struktur lagu (mesin `RH`, `mus2.js`; per adegan satu `cfg`):** satu putaran = 4 bar = 16 ketuk. Putaran 0 (pembuka): piano jarang + dengung rendah. Putaran 1: gitar petik + bas masuk. Putaran 2: melodi pemimpin (marimba atau seruling), senar lembut, perkusi halus. Putaran 3 (puncak): instrumen kedua menggandakan melodi (seruling <-> marimba) + lonceng. Adegan 5 putaran punya putaran 4 penutup tenang. Delapan lapis (`pno gtr bas str ld1 ld2 bel prc` + `pad`) diseimbangkan OTOMATIS: tiap lapis dirender sendiri, daya aktifnya diukur, lalu dikali agar sama dengan target (gtr .028, bas .030, ld1 .040, ld2 .022, pno .030, str .018, bel .012, prc .014, pad .008). Hasil dicampur dengan suara adegan dari mesin aplikasi (`renderMix(..., 'scene')`), musik diturunkan ke -9 dB dari suara adegan (RMS).
- **Per adegan (genre/warna):** pantai: G mayor, 96 bpm, gitar + marimba, perkusi penuh; tangga: C mayor, 104 bpm, gitar + marimba lincah, perkusi penuh; danau: A minor, 66 bpm, gitar lembut + seruling bervibrato, perkusi halus; kastil: D minor, 62 bpm, gitar pelan + seruling rendah, senar tebal, perkusi halus. 17 adegan lain BELUM bermusik; tiap adegan baru harus diberi genre sendiri (aturan 19b).
- **Transisi halus (permintaan 3):** (a) filter lowpass bus mulai di 55 persen lalu membuka sampai penuh di 1,9 putaran; (b) gema mulai 1,6x lalu turun ke nilai normal di titik yang sama; (c) jembatan: arpeggio piano naik (nada akord pertama + oktaf) di 2 ketuk terakhir putaran 0 dan senar mengembang (v .35) di bar terakhir putaran 0; (d) gitar di putaran 1 masuk dari 35 persen ke 100 persen bar demi bar; (e) bas baru masuk di bar ke-2 putaran 1.
- **Ombak dan hujan (permintaan 4), `patch158.py`, v156 -> v158, 7 penggantian tepat sekali, 3 blok script lolos `node --check`:** penyebab terdengar seperti radio tanpa sinyal: lapisan derau putih berfilter atas (ombak: `white highpass 4500`; hujan luar ruangan: `white highpass 5200` + pink bandpass 2600) yang rata dan terus-menerus. Perbaikan: (a) kejadian baru `surge` (satu gelombang: naik sekitar 2 dtk, pecah, surut 6 sampai 9 dtk; tiga lapis: badan brown lowpass 320 -> 140 Hz, buih pink bandpass 1500 -> 650 Hz, desis tipis pink bandpass 3000 -> 1800 Hz; kekuatan dan lama acak; sekitar 1 gelombang per 7 dtk) dipasang di `pantai` menggantikan 4 lapisan lama (kini 2 lapisan lembut + `surge`); `burst` diberi pilihan `loop` supaya derau lebih dari 4 dtk tidak terpotong; `surge` boleh lolos filter kepemilikan (`OWN`); (b) kejadian baru `patter` (butir hujan: 3 sampai 5 letupan derau 12 sampai 30 ms, bandpass 2,2 sampai 7 kHz, Q 2,2; 7 gugus per detik, badai 10) di atas desau lembut (pink bandpass 1300 Hz, + brown lowpass 420 Hz); lapisan derau putih 5200 DIBUANG; tetes `drip` diturunkan ke 1,2 per detik; (c) `surge` dan `patter` TIDAK ikut mengecilkan musik (seperti `drip`), supaya musik tidak tersendat tiap gelombang. Kekerasan pantai dikalibrasi ulang (naik 1,5x) agar RMS sama dengan yang lama (`RMS` lama -29,5 dBFS, baru -30,1).
- **UJI (`cmp158.py`, Chromium nyata, render luring, jam 13.00 dan 22.00):** sapuan 21 adegan x 3 cuaca (cerah, hujan, badai) x 2 jam = 126 render: 0 NaN, puncak maksimum 0,38 (batas 0,95), tak ada yang senyap; 0 galat halaman. Energi di atas 4 kHz (ciri desis radio): ombak 11,6 -> 0,3 persen; hujan pantai 16,1 -> 0,7; badai danau 26,3 -> 2,4; hujan padang 34,7 -> 21,6 (padang punya lapisan desis sendiri, tidak diubah). Naik-turun kekerasan per detik: ombak 51 -> 30 persen. Kekerasan: ombak -29,5 -> -30,1 dBFS; hujan pantai -29,1 -> -29,8; hujan padang -33,0 -> -33,2; badai -32,3 -> -32,2.
- **YANG TIDAK TERBUKTI / BATAS (jujur):** (1) BELUM ADA YANG MENDENGAR oleh saya: enak atau tidaknya lagu, transisi, ombak, dan hujan baru hanya bisa dinilai pemilik; angka di atas hanya ukuran proksi (desis, kekerasan), bukan bukti terdengar alami; (2) lagu BELUM masuk ke aplikasi: aplikasi masih memakai mesin musik sederhana Tahap 157 (`MUS`, 4 adegan, nada satu per satu); lagu 49 sampai 65 detik hanya contoh luring di halaman dengar; memasangnya butuh penjadwal langsung dengan posisi lagu (bagian demi bagian) dan itu belum dikerjakan; (3) tombol yang HANYA mematikan musik BELUM dibuat (sekarang speaker membisukan musik dan suara bersama); (4) 17 adegan lain belum bermusik dan belum diberi genre; (5) hanya `pantai` yang diganti ombaknya; `mercu`, `kapal`, `airterjun`, `padang` tidak diubah (`padang` hujan masih berdesis 21,6 persen di atas 4 kHz); (6) jalur LANGSUNG (aplikasi di HP) untuk `surge` dan `patter` hanya diuji lewat render luring dan sapuan, bukan didengar di aplikasi; laju `patter` 7 sampai 10 gugus per detik dengan penjaga 40 per jendela 1,6 dtk belum diukur beban CPU-nya di HP; (7) mutan cepat dan regresi `t155.py` TIDAK dijalankan (skrip tidak diunggah di sesi ini); (8) HP nyata dan Safari tidak diuji.
- **Berkas serah:** `daily-log.html` (v158), `PROGRESS-2.md`; halaman dengar (lagu 4 adegan + perbandingan ombak dan hujan lama/baru) di artefak yang dibagikan di chat. ```cmp158.py
import base64, subprocess, wave
import numpy as np
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
B64 = "window.B64 = f => new Promise(res => { const fr = new FileReader(); fr.onload = () => res(fr.result.split(',')[1]); fr.readAsDataURL(new Blob([f.buffer.slice(f.byteOffset, f.byteOffset + f.byteLength)])); });"
dec = lambda s: np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(s), dtype='<f4').astype(float)
def metrics(a):
    sp = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(a * np.hanning(len(a))))**2; fr = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(a), 1/44100)
    hf = sp[fr > 4000].sum() / sp.sum(); W = 22050; r = [np.sqrt(np.mean(a[i:i+W]**2)) for i in range(0, len(a) - W, W)]
    return hf * 100, np.std(r) / np.mean(r) * 100
def run(path, jobs):
    out = {}
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); err = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: err.append(str(e)))
        pg.goto('file://' + path, wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); pg.add_script_tag(content=B64)
        for k, (sc, m, wx, sec) in jobs.items(): out[k] = dec(pg.evaluate("async([sc,m,wx,s])=>window.B64(await window.DL.snd.render(sc,m,wx,s,7))", [sc, m, wx, sec]))
        sweep = None
        if path.endswith('v158.html'):
            sweep = pg.evaluate("""async () => { const S = window.DL.snd, bad = []; let n = 0, pk = 0;
              for (const sc of Object.keys(S.SND)) for (const wx of ['clear', 'rain', 'storm']) for (const m of [780, 1320]) { const a = await S.render(sc, m, wx, 5, 7); n++; let p = 0, nan = 0; for (const v of a) { if (!isFinite(v)) nan++; else if (Math.abs(v) > p) p = Math.abs(v); } if (nan || p > .95 || p < .0005) bad.push([sc, wx, m, nan, +p.toFixed(3)]); pk = Math.max(pk, p); }
              return { n, pk, bad: bad.slice(0, 8), nb: bad.length, scenes: Object.keys(S.SND).length }; }""")
        b.close()
    return out, err, sweep
J = {'ombak': ('pantai', 780, 'clear', 18), 'hujan-pantai': ('pantai', 780, 'rain', 18), 'hujan-padang': ('padang', 780, 'rain', 18), 'badai': ('danau', 1320, 'storm', 18)}
old, e1, _ = run('/mnt/user-data/uploads/daily-log.html', J); new, e2, sw = run('/home/claude/v158.html', J)
print('galat halaman lama/baru:', e1[:1], e2[:1]); print('sapuan baru:', sw)
def wr(fn, a):
    k = 3000; f = np.ones(len(a)); f[-k:] = np.linspace(1, 0, k); f[:1500] = np.linspace(0, 1, 1500); a = a * f
    with wave.open(fn, 'wb') as x: x.setnchannels(1); x.setsampwidth(2); x.setframerate(44100); x.writeframes((np.clip(a, -1, 1) * 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes())
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', fn, '-ac', '1', '-b:a', '64k', fn[:-4] + '.mp3'], check=True)
for k in J:
    g = .85 / max(np.abs(old[k]).max(), np.abs(new[k]).max()); ho, ao = metrics(old[k][44100:]); hn, an = metrics(new[k][44100:])
    print('RMS dBFS lama %.1f baru %.1f' % (20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(old[k]**2))), 20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(new[k]**2)))), end=' | '); print('%-13s puncak lama %.2f baru %.2f | energi >4kHz lama %.1f%% baru %.1f%% | naik-turun lama %.0f%% baru %.0f%%' % (k, np.abs(old[k]).max(), np.abs(new[k]).max(), ho, hn, ao, an))
    wr('c5/%s-lama.wav' % k, old[k] * g); wr('c5/%s-baru.wav' % k, new[k] * g)

window.RH = async function (cfg, T, seed, layers, gains) {
  const SR = 44100, oc = new OfflineAudioContext(1, SR * T, SR); let s = seed >>> 0; const r = () => ((s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296);
  const hz = m => 440 * Math.pow(2, (m - 69) / 12);
  const bus = oc.createBiquadFilter(); bus.type = 'lowpass'; bus.frequency.value = cfg.lp;
  const dry = oc.createGain(), wet = oc.createGain(), out = oc.createGain(), cv = oc.createConvolver(), wl = oc.createBiquadFilter();
  const L = Math.floor(SR * 3.4), ir = oc.createBuffer(1, L, SR), d = ir.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < L; i++) d[i] = (r() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / L, 3);
  cv.buffer = ir; wl.type = 'lowpass'; wl.frequency.value = 3500; wet.gain.value = cfg.wet;
  bus.connect(dry); bus.connect(cv); cv.connect(wl); wl.connect(wet); dry.connect(out); wet.connect(out); out.connect(oc.destination);
  const osc = (ty, f, t, du, dest) => { const o = oc.createOscillator(); o.type = ty; o.frequency.value = f; o.connect(dest); o.start(t); o.stop(t + du); return o; };
  const G = (t, a, dec, pk) => { const g = oc.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(pk, t + a); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + a + dec); g.connect(bus); return g; };
  const piano = (t, m, v) => { const f = hz(m); [[1, 1, 3], [2, .3, 2], [3, .1, 1.2], [4, .04, .8]].forEach(([k, a, dc]) => osc('sine', f * k, t, dc + .2, G(t, .01, dc, v * a))); };
  const pluck = (t, m, v) => { const f = hz(m), fl = oc.createBiquadFilter(), g = G(t, .004, 1.2, v); fl.type = 'lowpass'; fl.Q.value = 1; fl.frequency.setValueAtTime(3000, t); fl.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500, t + .4); fl.connect(g); osc('sawtooth', f, t, 1.4, fl); osc('triangle', f * 2.003, t, 1.4, fl); };
  const mar = (t, m, v) => { const f = hz(m); osc('sine', f, t, .9, G(t, .003, .6, v)); osc('sine', f * 4, t, .3, G(t, .002, .12, v * .25)); osc('sine', f * 10, t, .1, G(t, .001, .05, v * .06)); };
  const flute = (t, m, du, v) => { const f = hz(m), g = oc.createGain(), g2 = oc.createGain(), l = oc.createOscillator(), lg = oc.createGain(), o = oc.createOscillator(), o2 = oc.createOscillator();
    o.frequency.value = f; o2.frequency.value = f * 2; g2.gain.value = .12; l.frequency.value = 5; lg.gain.value = f * .005; l.connect(lg); lg.connect(o.frequency); o.connect(g); o2.connect(g2); g2.connect(g);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v, t + .15); g.gain.setValueAtTime(v, t + Math.max(.2, du - .3)); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + du); g.connect(bus); [o, o2, l].forEach(x => { x.start(t); x.stop(t + du + .05); }); };

  gains = gains || {};
  const P = (l, fn, ...a) => { if (layers && !layers.includes(l)) return; a[a.length - 1] *= (gains[l] || 1); fn(...a); };
  const bass = (t, m, v) => { osc('sine', hz(m), t, 2, G(t, .02, 1.4, v)); osc('triangle', hz(m), t, 2, G(t, .02, 1, v * .4)); };
  const strn = (t, m, du, v) => { const g = oc.createGain(), fl = oc.createBiquadFilter(); fl.type = 'lowpass'; fl.frequency.value = 1300; fl.connect(g); g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v, t + 1.1); g.gain.setValueAtTime(v, t + du - 1); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + du); g.connect(bus); [.997, 1.003].forEach(k => osc('sawtooth', hz(m) * k, t, du + .05, fl)); };
  const bell = (t, m, v) => { const f = hz(m); osc('sine', f, t, 1.8, G(t, .003, 1.5, v)); osc('sine', f * 2.76, t, .8, G(t, .003, .6, v * .3)); };
  const kick = (t, v) => { const o = oc.createOscillator(), g = G(t, .003, .28, v); o.frequency.setValueAtTime(120, t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(48, t + .14); o.connect(g); o.start(t); o.stop(t + .4); };
  const nb = oc.createBuffer(1, SR * .2, SR), nd = nb.getChannelData(0); for (let i = 0; i < nd.length; i++) nd[i] = r() * 2 - 1;
  const shk = (t, v) => { const s = oc.createBufferSource(), h = oc.createBiquadFilter(), g = oc.createGain(); s.buffer = nb; h.type = 'highpass'; h.frequency.value = 6500; g.gain.setValueAtTime(v, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + .07); s.connect(h); h.connect(g); g.connect(dry); s.start(t); s.stop(t + .12); };
  const sp = 60 / cfg.bpm, LP = 16 * sp, N = cfg.N, last = N - 1, wind = N >= 5, oth = cfg.lead === 'f' ? 'm' : 'f';
  const ld = (k, t, m, du, v) => k === 'f' ? flute(t, m, du * sp, v) : mar(t, m, v);
  const genP = (a, b, gap) => { let t = a; while (t < b) { const n = 2 + Math.floor(r() * 3); let i = Math.floor(r() * cfg.pool.length), dir = r() < .6 ? 1 : -1; for (let k = 0; k < n && t < b; k++) { P('pno', piano, t, cfg.pool[i], cfg.pv * (.7 + .5 * r())); i = Math.max(0, Math.min(cfg.pool.length - 1, i + dir * (1 + Math.floor(r() * 2)))); if (r() < .2) dir = -dir; t += .6 + r() * .5; } t += gap[0] + r() * (gap[1] - gap[0]); } };
  bus.frequency.setValueAtTime(cfg.lp * .55, 0); bus.frequency.setValueAtTime(cfg.lp * .55, LP * .7); bus.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(cfg.lp, LP * 1.9); wet.gain.setValueAtTime(cfg.wet * 1.6, 0); wet.gain.setValueAtTime(cfg.wet * 1.6, LP * .7); wet.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(cfg.wet, LP * 1.9);
  { const g = oc.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, 0); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.012 * (gains.pad || 1), 4); g.connect(bus); if (!layers || layers.includes('pad')) [1, 1.004].forEach(k => osc('sine', hz(cfg.drone) * k, 0, T, g)); }
  { const c0 = cfg.chords[0], nn = c0.t.concat([c0.t[0] + 12]); nn.forEach((m, k) => P('pno', piano, LP - 2 * sp + k * .5 * sp, m, cfg.pv * (.6 + .25 * k))); }
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const t0 = i * LP, w = wind && i === last, full = i >= 3 && !w, mid = i >= 2;
    if (i === 0) genP(t0 + .8, t0 + LP, [1, 2.2]); else if (i === 1) genP(t0 + 1, t0 + LP, [3, 6]); else if (w) genP(t0 + 1, t0 + LP, [2, 4]);
    cfg.chords.forEach((c, bi) => { const bt = t0 + bi * 4 * sp, bm = c.b >= 48 ? c.b - 12 : c.b;
      if (i >= 1) { const ramp = i === 1 ? .35 + .65 * bi / 3 : 1; cfg.pat.forEach(([b, x], k) => P('gtr', pluck, bt + b * sp, x ? c.t[x - 1] : c.b, ramp * cfg.gv * (b === 0 ? 1.3 : (k % 2 ? .8 : 1)))); if (i > 1 || bi >= 1) { P('bas', bass, bt, bm, 1); P('bas', bass, bt + 2 * sp, bm, .8); } }
      if (i === 0 && bi === 3) c.t.forEach(m => P('str', strn, bt, m, 4 * sp, .35));
      if (mid) c.t.forEach(m => P('str', strn, bt, m, 4 * sp, .5));
      if (mid && !w && cfg.perc) for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) { if (cfg.perc > 1) { if (b % 2 === 0) P('prc', kick, bt + b * sp, .5); P('prc', shk, bt + (b + .5) * sp, .4); } P('prc', shk, bt + b * sp, .25); }
      if (full) for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { const tt = bt + r() * 3.6 * sp, mm = c.t[Math.floor(r() * 3)] + 12 * (1 + Math.floor(r() * 2)); P('bel', bell, tt, mm, .5); }
    });
    if (mid) cfg.mel.forEach(([b, m, du]) => { const t = t0 + b * sp; P('ld1', ld, cfg.lead, t, m, du, cfg.lv); if (full) P('ld2', ld, oth, t, m, du, cfg.lv * .7); });
  }
  return (await oc.startRendering()).getChannelData(0);
};
window.B64 = f => new Promise(res => { const fr = new FileReader(); fr.onload = () => res(fr.result.split(',')[1]); fr.readAsDataURL(new Blob([f.buffer.slice(f.byteOffset, f.byteOffset + f.byteLength)])); });
window.ACT = f => { const W = 4410, n = Math.floor(f.length / W), a = []; let mx = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { let e = 0; for (let j = 0; j < W; j++) { const v = f[i * W + j]; e += v * v; } a.push(Math.sqrt(e / W)); if (a[i] > mx) mx = a[i]; } const k = a.filter(x => x > .15 * mx); return Math.sqrt(k.reduce((s, x) => s + x * x, 0) / (k.length || 1)); };

import base64, subprocess, wave, importlib.util, sys
import numpy as np
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
sys.argv = ['x']; src = open('render2.py').read().split("MIN =")[0]; exec(src.split("def wr")[0].replace("import json, subprocess, wave", "").replace("from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright", ""))
MIN = {'pantai':780,'kastil':1320,'danau':1080,'tangga':780}
EX = {'pantai':(5,2),'tangga':(5,2),'danau':(4,1),'kastil':(4,1)}
TG = dict(gtr=.028, bas=.030, ld1=.040, ld2=.022, pno=.030, str=.018, bel=.012, prc=.014, pad=.008)
def wr(fn, a):
    n = len(a); f = np.ones(n); k = int(44100*4); f[-k:] = np.linspace(1, 0, k); f[:1000] = np.linspace(0, 1, 1000); a = a * f
    with wave.open(fn, 'wb') as x: x.setnchannels(1); x.setsampwidth(2); x.setframerate(44100); x.writeframes((np.clip(a, -1, 1) * 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes())
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-loglevel','error','-i',fn,'-ac','1','-b:a','56k',fn[:-4]+'.mp3'], check=True)
rms = lambda a: float(np.sqrt(np.mean(a**2)))
dec = lambda s: np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(s), dtype='<f4').astype(float)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox']); pg = b.new_page(); err = []; pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: err.append(str(e)))
    pg.goto('file:///mnt/user-data/uploads/daily-log.html', wait_until='load'); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); pg.add_script_tag(content=open('mus2.js').read())
    for sc in __import__('os').environ.get('SC','pantai tangga danau kastil').split():
        N, pc = EX[sc]; cfg = dict(S[sc]); cfg.update(pool=M[sc]['pool'], drone=M[sc]['drone'], pv=.2, N=N, perc=pc, wet=.4)
        T = round(N * 16 * 60 / cfg['bpm'] + 3, 2)
        act = {l: pg.evaluate("async([c,T,l])=>window.ACT(await window.RH(c,T,5,[l],{}))", [cfg, T, l]) for l in TG}
        gains = {l: (TG[l] / act[l] if act[l] > 1e-6 else 1) for l in TG}
        mu = dec(pg.evaluate("async([c,T,g])=>window.B64(await window.RH(c,T,5,null,g))", [cfg, T, gains]))
        scn = dec(pg.evaluate("async([sc,m,T])=>window.B64(await window.DL.snd.renderMix(sc,m,'clear',T,7,'scene'))", [sc, MIN[sc], T]))
        n = min(len(mu), len(scn)); mu, scn = mu[:n], scn[:n]
        mus = mu * (rms(scn) * 10**(-9/20) / (rms(mu) + 1e-9)); both = scn + mus; both *= .85 / np.abs(both).max()
        mo = mu * min(.85 / np.abs(mu).max(), .1 / (rms(mu) + 1e-9))
        wr('c4/%s-both.wav' % sc, both); wr('c4/%s-music.wav' % sc, mo)
        print(sc, 'T', T, 'N', N, 'ganho', {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in gains.items()}, 'NaN' if np.isnan(mu).any() else 'ok', 'puncak musik %.2f' % np.abs(mu).max(), flush=True)
    print('galat:', err[:2]); b.close()
